lines.en: People are starting to ask about that thing you promised.
lines.zh: 您应下那件事，茶桌上已经有人问起来了。

lines.en: See you at the lanterns tonight. Don't be late.
lines.zh: 晚上灯会见，别来晚了。

lines.en: Next time someone asks what happened to the bridge, I'll tell them what came out in public.
lines.zh: 再有人问桥是怎么坏的，我就照当众说的那一回讲。

lines.en: Both families sat at the same table and finished the pot today. They stayed till the end.
lines.zh: 这一壶茶两家同桌喝完了，今儿总算坐得住。

lines.en: Take care out there. If you hear anything else, come and tell me when you have time.
lines.zh: 您路上慢些，要是又打听到什么，得空来讲给我听。

lines.en: Come back for tea sometime.
lines.zh: 回头再来喝茶。

text.en: The teahouse keeper set tables at the bridgehead and gave everyone who crossed a bowl of tea.
text.zh: 茶馆老板娘把茶桌摆到了桥头，过桥的人每人一碗茶。

text.en: Someone asked over tea how the bridge had broken, and the teahouse keeper set down the pot to tell the story again as it had come out in public.
text.zh: 有人端着茶问桥是怎么坏的，老板娘放下壶，把那天当众讲清的经过又说了一遍。

text.en: The two families sat at one table over tea. The teahouse keeper carried the tray round and could not stop smiling.
text.zh: 两家人坐在一张桌上喝茶。茶馆老板娘端着茶盘，笑得合不拢嘴。

text.en: The teahouse keeper set up a stall by the bridge. As people sat down for tea, they went over the families' guesses about how it broke all over again.
text.zh: 茶馆老板娘在桥边摆了摊子，来客一坐下喝茶，各家的猜法又从头讲了一遍。

text.en: The teahouse keeper half shut the door, still going on about the bridge that never got mended.
text.zh: 茶馆老板娘关了半扇门，嘴里还念叨着那座没修好的桥。

guess_heard.en: {teller} muttered a few words to me about it. {hedge} {line}.

guess_unknown.en: Who started it, I couldn't say. {hedge} {line}.
There's talk about, but who began it I don't know. {hedge} {line}.
guess_unknown.zh: 风声是有，谁传的就不知道了。{hedge}{line}。

heard.en: Come to think of it, {teller} told me {line}.
heard.zh: 说到这事，{teller}倒跟我提过，说{line}。

heard.en: I got this from {teller}, who told me that {line}.

known.en: {line}. Who in this town doesn't know?
{line}. Everyone who comes for tea knows that.

rival.en: But I've also heard from {teller}, who says that {line}.
rival.zh: 可我又听{teller}说起过这事，说{line}。

rival.en: Then there's the account I heard from {teller}, that {line}.
rival.zh: 还有{teller}那边的说法。{line}。

seen.en: I was there at the time and witnessed that {line}.
seen.zh: 我那时就在跟前，亲眼瞧见{line}。

seen.en: I was right there when I saw that {line}.

unknown.en: Someone told me that {line}.
Who was it that told me? What I heard was that {line}.
unknown.zh: 是谁跟我说的来着？说是{line}。

lines.en: Are you the new Manager? Come and sit down. I'll pour you a bowl of tea.
lines.zh: 您就是新来的总管吧？别站着，过来坐，我给您倒碗茶。

lines.en: Manager, you didn't do what you promised. It's being talked about at every table.
lines.zh: 总管，您答应人家的事没办。茶桌上都在讲了。

lines.en: The lantern parade is tonight, so I've carried the tea tables out to the street corner.
lines.zh: 今晚游灯，我把茶桌都搬到街口去了。

lines.en: I've poured tea for those two families for years, and at last I've seen Granny Li and Shopkeeper Zhou at the same table.
lines.zh: 我在这儿给两家倒了这么多年的茶，今儿可算见着李家老太太跟周掌柜坐一张桌了。

lines.en: You finally cleared up what happened at the bridge. I felt something was off, but I couldn't put my finger on it.
lines.zh: 您可把桥的事讲明白了，我先前只觉着不对劲，可真说不出哪儿不对。

lines.en: When the customers ask after that promise of yours, I can tell them you kept it.
lines.zh: 客人问您答应的事办了没有，我这下也好告诉人家，您把事办成了。

lines.en: Li Er's business was put straight in front of a full room. I was standing right there.
lines.zh: 李家老二的事当着一屋子人说清了，我就在边上听着。

lines.en: Back again? Sit down, the tea's still hot.
lines.zh: 又来啦？您坐，茶还热着。

lines.en: Have a seat. Someone was talking about you in here just now.
lines.zh: 您坐。刚才还有人在这儿说起您呢。

lines.en: The tea's just brewed. Have a bowl first.
lines.zh: 茶刚沏好，您先喝一碗。

lines.en: Come and sit over here. Nobody will hear us in this corner.
lines.zh: 来，坐这边。这儿说话没人听得见。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. Now there's some hope for the bridge.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料送到桥边了。这下桥有指望了。

bamboo_arrived.en: There's bamboo stacked at the bridge, and everyone coming in for tea is talking about it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 桥边堆上竹子了，来喝茶的都在说。

batch_promised.en: All right. It goes over first thing tomorrow.
Don't worry. It'll be there at first light.

busy.en: Please give me a moment. I've a room full of people waiting for their tea and can't get away just now.
busy.zh: 劳您等一等，满屋子客人都等着续水，我这会儿实在腾不出手。

busy.en: The water in the back isn't boiling yet and another table just sat down out front. You go on with your day.
busy.zh: 后头的水还没烧开，前头又坐下一桌。您先忙您的。

cannot.en: I really can't help there. I hardly ever get out of the teahouse.
cannot.zh: 这个我真帮不上，我连茶馆门都难得出。

cannot.en: I can't do that for you. You'll have to find someone else.
cannot.zh: 这忙我帮不了，您另找人吧。

caught.en: I thought you'd told me in earnest. It turns out you fobbed me off with a lie. I'll ask a few more questions next time.
caught.zh: 我还当您是认认真真跟我说的，原来拿了句假话打发我。以后您再说什么，我总得多问两句。

caught.en: It was a lie? I passed it around to the other tables.
caught.zh: 那话是假的？我还替你传过几桌呢。

closed.en: Not now. Wait till the crowd thins out a bit.
closed.zh: 这会儿不行，等客人散了些再说。

closed.en: I've no time to spare just now. Try me at another hour.
closed.zh: 眼下腾不出空来，您换个时辰来。

deal.en: All right, we've got a deal.
All right, we'll do it your way.

doubted.en: I've heard another account over tea. Who did you get yours from?
doubted.zh: 茶桌上还有别的说法，您这话是跟谁问来的？

doubted.en: That's not right. What I heard in here was different.
doubted.zh: 不对呀，我这儿听来的是另一个样。

elder_no.en: A few words like that aren't enough for me yet.
That's still a long way short.

elder_yes.en: Now I follow. Let's do it that way.
elder_yes.zh: 这下我听明白了，就这么办吧。

elder_yes.en: I follow now. Go ahead.
elder_yes.zh: 这回我听懂了。您接着办吧。

empty.en: Anyone can say that. Tell me again when it's done.
empty.zh: 嘴上说说谁都会。等您真办了再讲。

empty.en: I hear that sort of thing several times a day.
empty.zh: 这种话我一天要听好几回。

evade.en: Oh, that one I can't tell. Though... no, don't ask me.
evade.zh: 这个呀，我可不能讲。不过……算了，您别问了。

evade.en: I promised I wouldn't pass that one on.
evade.zh: 这事我答应过人家，不往外说的。

gift_dislike.en: I've no use for {item}. I don't make lanterns.
Some {item}. Take it to the lantern workshop. They can use it there.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊，您拿去扎灯坊吧。那儿用得着。

gift_like.en: Oh, {item}, just what I was short of. Thank you. Your next tea's on me.
gift_like.zh: {item}啊，我正缺这个。谢谢您，回头请您喝茶。

gift_like.en: I'll take the {item}. You do know how to choose.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? I brew tea all day, I've plenty. But thank you.
gift_neutral.zh: {item}？我这儿天天泡，不缺。不过谢谢您。

gift_neutral.en: Some {item} will do. Put them on the counter.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. Any more and there'll be nowhere to stack it.
goods_enough.zh: 桥边的{item}已经够了，再送就堆不下了。

goods_enough.en: There's plenty of {item} now. No need to send more to the bridge.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that rumour is cleared up in front of everyone, there's nothing to talk about.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当着大家说清楚，这事没法谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear that rumour up in public first. Then we'll talk about the rest.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先把那些闲话当众说清楚，别的再说。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is passing that rumour round and you haven't said a word. I can't say yes to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 满镇都在传那些闲话，您一句话也不说。这事我不能点头。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: That rumour comes up at my tables every day and you keep quiet about it. I won't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 茶桌上天天在讲那些闲话，您倒一声不吭。这个我不应。

hard_other.zh: 这个不行，说什么也不行。

keeper_no.en: This is the first time we've dealt with each other. There's no hurry for that.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们才头一回打交道，这个先不急。

keeper_no.en: I don't show that to a new face. Come by a few more times first.
keeper_no.zh: 生客我可不敢随便给看。您多来几回再说。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you said. I'll be telling people about that.
kept_thanks.zh: 您说到做到，这个我得跟大伙儿讲讲。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you promised, and I won't forget it.
kept_thanks.zh: 您答应的真办了，我记着您的好。

knew.en: I heard that a while ago. It's been told in here a few times already.
knew.zh: 这事我早听说了，在我这儿都讲过好几回了。

knew.en: Someone told that one in here before you did.
knew.zh: 您说的这个，早有人在我这儿讲过了。

needs_nod.en: That's not mine to decide. I'd have to ask the clan elder.
needs_nod.zh: 这个我做不了主，得先问问族长。

needs_nod.en: The elder hasn't said yes, and I won't settle it on my own.
needs_nod.zh: 族长没发话，我可不敢拍板。

not_said.en: I didn't pass that around. Where did you hear it?
not_said.zh: 这句话不是我传出去的，您是在哪儿听见的？

not_said.en: Those words never left my mouth.
not_said.zh: 这话不是从我嘴里出去的。

not_so.en: No, that's not how it went.
You heard that wrong. It wasn't like that.

nothing_to_say.en: That's one I can't say a word about.
For once, I've got nothing to say about it.
nothing_to_say.zh: 难得，这事我还真没话说。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's been said out in front of a whole room, so I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 话当着一屋子人说开了，我也就不拦着了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Good, it's out in the open. I've nothing more to say against it.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说开了就好。我这边没话讲了。

point_heard.en: I couldn't tell you much myself, but I heard {name} say something about it. If you want the full story, try asking there.
point_heard.zh: 这事我也说不上来，倒听{name}讲过几句。您真想问清楚，不妨去找找。

point_heard.en: The bit I heard came from {name}. You'd better ask there for the whole of it.
point_heard.zh: 我那半句是从{name}那里听来的，您要听全了，还是去问问吧。

point_hub.en: I can't say for sure. Ask {name}, who may know more.
point_hub.zh: 这事我也说不准。您去问问{name}，兴许知道得多些。

point_hub.en: Nothing's reached me. Ask {name}, who hears plenty.
point_hub.zh: 我这儿没听到。{name}那边消息多，您去问问。

promise_open.en: I said yes to that already. It's {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这事我应下了的，{when}把{amount}根{item}送到桥边。

promise_open.en: That's settled. I'll have {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}, without fail.
promise_open.zh: 说好了的。{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边，误不了。

said_already.en: Didn't I just tell you that?
said_already.zh: 刚才不是跟您讲过了吗？

said_already.en: I told you that already. Think back.
said_already.zh: 这个我说过了，您再想想。

testified.en: I got a good look.
testified.zh: 那一眼我可看清了。

testified.en: I was there this time. Saw it plain.
testified.zh: 这回我就在场。看得真真的。

timeout.en: The water's boiling and the pots need filling. Come and sit again later.
timeout.zh: 水开了，我得去灌壶。您回头再来坐。

timeout.en: That table's calling for more water. We'll pick this up next time.
timeout.zh: 那桌客人在叫我添水。咱们下回接着说。

too_late.en: It's this late already and I'm putting the shutters up. Come in the morning and I'll keep a pot hot for you.
too_late.zh: 都这个时辰了，我要上门板了。明早来，给您留壶热茶。

too_late.en: It's dark and the teahouse is closing. Come early tomorrow.
too_late.zh: 天黑了，茶馆要关门了。明天一早再来吧。

took_in.en: Now that I've heard your account, I understand.
took_in.zh: 这回听你从头说了一遍，我总算弄明白了。

took_in.en: That makes sense now. Next time someone asks, I'll know what to say.
took_in.zh: 这就说得通了，下回有人问起来，我也知道该怎么答。

turned_down.en: Sorry, that's one I can't agree to.
I can't agree to that. Please don't press me.
turned_down.zh: 这事我应不下来，您别为难我了。

unknown.en: Nobody has ever brought that up in here.
unknown.zh: 这个还真没人在我这儿说起过。

unknown.en: Nobody's mentioned it in here.

will_ask.en: All right, I'll go and sound them out for you.
I'll pass that on for you. Carrying word is something I'm good at.
will_ask.zh: 这话我替您带到。传话这种事，我在行。

will_call.en: I'll have everyone who comes in for tea pass the word. See you at the hall shortly.
will_call.zh: 我让来喝茶的都捎个信。一会儿祠堂见。

will_call.en: That's easy. Half the town drinks tea in here. I'll go and call them now.
will_call.zh: 这事好办，半个镇的人都在我这儿喝茶。我这就去喊。

will_do.en: Fine, just leave it to me.
All right. I'll see to it as soon as this pot boils.
will_do.zh: 好，等这壶水开了我就去办。

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I won't add a word to it.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这些，多一句我也不添。

witness_in_public.en: I can give you the part I saw. I won't fill in the rest.
witness_in_public.zh: 我先说看见的那一段，别的我可不敢补。

lines.en: A word ought to count...
lines.zh: 说话得算话……

lines.en: When the gong sounds, fall in.
lines.zh: 锣一响，你就跟上。

lines.en: Now that the bridge business is settled, I can have a drink in peace.
lines.zh: 桥的事说清了，我也能安心喝一口了。

lines.en: Talk again at night.
lines.zh: 夜里再说吧。

lines.en: I must catch some sleep.
lines.zh: 我得去眯一会儿。

text.en: The Night Watchman led the parade with the gong. The Manager kept the promise, and that night people stopped to hear the watchman's account.
text.zh: 更夫打着锣走在游灯队前头。总管应的事办到了，这一夜也有人停下来听更夫说话。

text.en: The Night Watchman led the parade with the gong. When the watchman spoke about the bridge that night, nobody cut in.
text.zh: 更夫打着锣走在游灯队前头。这一夜讲起桥的事，没人再打岔了。

text.en: The watchman walked one more round across the bridge, lighter on the feet than usual.
text.zh: 更夫在桥上多走了一趟，脚步比往常轻快。

text.en: The watchman walked the lane with a lantern, muttering that it was too narrow.
text.zh: 更夫提着灯笼巡了夹道，嘟囔着这条路太窄。

text.en: The watchman went past the empty bridgehead alone, striking the gong.
text.zh: 更夫独自敲着锣，从空荡荡的桥头走了过去。

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. Don't pass that on just yet.

guess_unknown.en: No idea who said it. {hedge} {line}.
I only caught a few words, and {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: The word I had from {teller} was that {line}.
That's a bit I heard from {teller}, who said that {line}.
heard.zh: 这句是{teller}讲给我听的，说是{line}。

known.en: {line}. Even a night watchman knows that...

rival.en: But I heard {teller} say that {line}.
rival.zh: {teller}没这么讲，倒说{line}。

rival.en: Then there's {teller}'s account, that {line}. It doesn't fit.
rival.zh: 还有{teller}讲的我可对不上，说是{line}。

seen.en: {line}. That part I saw clearly.
What I saw at the time was that {line}.

unknown.en: What got to me was that {line}.
I heard someone say that {line}. Didn't catch who.
unknown.zh: 有人这么讲，说{line}。是谁没留意。

lines.en: Were you looking for me, Manager? They call me the Night Watchman. If it's about the night, ask away.
lines.zh: 总管找我？镇上人叫我更夫，你若要打听夜里的事，就直说吧。

lines.en: You said you would... never mind. A watchman doesn't expect much.
lines.zh: 你应的事……算了，打更的也不指望。

lines.en: Tonight I strike the gong at the head of the lantern parade. The drink... can wait till tomorrow.
lines.zh: 今夜游灯，我敲锣开道。酒……明天再喝。

lines.en: Now that people know what happened, I'll have an answer if it comes up on my rounds.
lines.zh: 大伙儿既然都听明白了，夜里再有人议论，我也有话答。

lines.en: I used to watch every step near the bridge on my rounds. With it mended, I can walk there easy.
lines.zh: 从前夜里走到桥边，我总得留神脚下。这会儿桥修好了，巡起夜来也踏实。

lines.en: You did what you said you'd do, and I appreciate it.
lines.zh: 你答应的事都办妥了，这份情我领。

lines.en: The talk about Li Er was cleared in public. Even the watch post heard of it.
lines.zh: 李二那闲话当众说清了。更铺里都听说了。

lines.en: What, back again?
lines.zh: 怎么又来了？

lines.en: Go on, I'm listening.
lines.zh: 说吧，我听着。

lines.en: Take your time. I don't like to be hurried.
lines.zh: 有话慢慢说，我不爱急。

lines.en: Walked the rounds all night and my legs still ache.
lines.zh: 巡了一夜，腿还酸着。

asleep.en: You call out. The Night Watchman sleeps on.

bamboo_arrived.en: Bamboo's at the bridge.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到桥边了。

bamboo_arrived.en: The stock's here. I watched it come.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料到了，我看着送来的。

batch_promised.en: Right. It'll be there in the morning.
I'll bring it at first light. Don't rush me.

busy.en: I'm on duty. Later.
busy.zh: 我正当着值，回头再说。

busy.en: Let me finish this round. I'll hear you when I get back.
busy.zh: 你让我先巡完这一圈，有话等我回头再讲。

cannot.en: Can't help you there.
Not something I can do.

caught.en: I believed what you told me. Next time I'll think twice.
caught.zh: 我原先信了你的话，往后再听见可得先掂量掂量。

caught.en: No wonder the more I thought about it, the less it fit. You made it up.
caught.zh: 难怪这话越想越不对，原来是你编的。

closed.en: I can't stop right now. We'll talk when I'm free.
closed.zh: 这会儿走不开，等我得了空再说。

closed.en: I sleep in the morning. Come in the afternoon.
closed.zh: 上午我得睡觉，下午再来。

deal.en: All right, that's how it'll be.

doubted.en: Wait a minute. That's not the same account I heard.
doubted.zh: 等等，你讲的跟我听见的不是一回事。

doubted.en: That's the part I'm wondering about. Where did you hear it?
doubted.zh: 我就奇怪这一点，你打哪儿听来的？

elder_no.en: Just that? Not enough.
Still short. I won't nod.

elder_yes.en: Right, I get it.
You've got a point. It stands.

empty.en: Empty talk. I don't care for it.
Anyone can talk... bring something real.
empty.zh: 光说谁不会……拿点实的来。

evade.en: I'm just the watchman. I can't keep track of all that.
evade.zh: 我就是个打更的，管不了那么多。

evade.en: That... let's leave it.

gift_dislike.en: I'm not much of a one for {item}... thanks all the same.
Some {item}, eh... wine would have been better. Never mind, thanks.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊……要是换成酒就好了。算了，谢谢。

gift_like.en: This {item} is for me? Then... then I won't say no.
Ah, {item}... good stuff. It'll keep me warm on the rounds tonight.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}... that'll do. Thanks.
Some {item}. Thanks. Might come in handy at night.

goods_enough.en: Enough {item}. Stop hauling.
The {item}'s piled up at the bridge. It's enough.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear that rumour in public, or there's no bamboo.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清，别想借竹子。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Settle the rumour first. The rest can wait.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 闲话先说清楚，别的再谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is talking and you haven't made a sound. I won't agree.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上都在传，你一声不吭。我不应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Gossip all over the street, and you keep quiet, Manager... forget it.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话满街跑，总管不吭声……这事免了。

keeper_no.en: We've only met a few times. I can't show you this yet.
keeper_no.zh: 咱俩才见过几面，这东西还不能给你看。

keeper_no.en: Strangers don't ask. That's the rule.
keeper_no.zh: 生人别问，这是规矩。

kept_thanks.en: You played it straight. I'll remember.
kept_thanks.zh: 你没糊弄人，我记着。

kept_thanks.en: I thought you were just saying it, but you really did see it through.
kept_thanks.zh: 原想着你只是一说，你倒真把事办了。

knew.en: Knew that already.
I knew... no need to say it again.

needs_nod.en: Have to ask the elder first.
I'm only the watchman. It's not my call.
needs_nod.zh: 我一个打更的，做不了主。

not_said.en: That wasn't me talking.
Those words never came out of my mouth.
not_said.zh: 这话没从我嘴里出去过。

nothing_to_say.en: Nothing to tell.
Didn't see a thing.

objection_withdrawn.en: Now it's out in the open, I'll stop standing in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 既然说开了，我不拦了。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's cleared. No use blocking it.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清了，拦着也没用。

point_heard.en: I heard a word from {name} but didn't ask for the details. You'd best ask there.
point_heard.zh: 我听{name}提过一嘴，也没问个明白，你自己去问吧。

point_heard.en: I didn't ask for details. I heard it from {name}. Try asking there.
point_heard.zh: 我没细问，是{name}跟我提的，你去问问吧。

point_hub.en: I couldn't tell you much about that. Try {name}. More of the town's talk gets there.
point_hub.zh: 这事我说不明白，你去找{name}问问，镇上的话那里听得多。

point_hub.en: I don't know... for town talk, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我不知道……镇上的事，去问{name}。

promise_open.en: Said yes already. It's {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 应了的，{when}把{amount}根{item}送到桥边。

promise_open.en: Agreed ages ago... I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} over {when}.
promise_open.zh: 早应了……{when}送{amount}根{item}过去。

said_already.en: Said it already. Don't drag it out.
I just said... didn't you hear?

testified.en: I saw it at night with my own eyes. It's true.
testified.zh: 夜里我亲眼看见的，不假。

testified.en: You asked what I saw on my round. This is all I saw.
testified.zh: 你问我打更时看见什么，我只瞧见这些。

timeout.en: Time to strike the watch. Got to go.
timeout.zh: 该敲更了，得走了。

timeout.en: Two more rounds before dawn...
timeout.zh: 天亮前还得再巡两趟……

too_late.en: It's late. Go and get some rest.
It's nearly dawn. Ask me in the morning.

took_in.en: Right. I'll bear what you said in mind on my rounds.
took_in.zh: 成，你刚才说的，我巡夜时留个心。

took_in.en: Got it. I'll watch more closely at night.
took_in.zh: 知道了，夜里我多看着点。

turned_down.en: No. Nothing to discuss.
I can't say yes to that.

unknown.en: That... I didn't notice.
Never heard a word of it.

will_ask.en: Right, I'll take the message.
I'll ask on my round.

will_call.en: Right. I'll bang the gong and call people.
will_call.zh: 好，我敲着锣去喊人。

will_call.en: I'll shout my way through town. See you at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我一路喊过去，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Right. I'll do it on my way round.
All right, I'll go round there.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. Nothing else.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这些，别的没有。

witness_in_public.en: I've told what I saw. What I didn't see, I won't mention.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见的我说了，没看见的不提。

lines.en: Mother is still waiting to hear from you.
lines.zh: 娘还等着你的话。

lines.en: See you at the lanterns.
lines.zh: 灯会上见。

lines.en: Now that it's out in the open, I can go home and tell Mother.
lines.zh: 这回话都说开了，我回去也好跟娘说。

lines.en: Use what's at the bridge for now. If you need more, come to me.
lines.zh: 桥边那批先用着，还要竹料就来找我。

lines.en: I have bamboo to count. I'll be off.
lines.zh: 我还得点竹料，先走了。

lines.en: Come back when you have news.
lines.zh: 有消息再来。

text.en: Li Da went on counting the bamboo and didn't bring up the Manager's promise again.
text.zh: 李大照旧点竹料，没再提起总管答应过的事。

text.en: Li Da carried the last pole onto the bridge. Everything the Manager promised Li Da was made good at the festival.
text.zh: 李大扛着最后一根竹竿上了桥。总管许李大的，灯会上都兑现了。

text.en: Li Da carried the last pole onto the bridge. The railing went up, and the Li family's lantern hung at the very front.
text.zh: 李大扛着最后一根竹竿上了桥。栏杆立起来了，李家的灯挂在最前头。

text.en: Li Da crossed the bridge side by side with the Zhou family, and nobody brought up the old quarrel.
text.zh: 李大跟周家的人一起过了桥，谁也没提旧账。

text.en: Li Da stayed by the bamboo stack at the bridgehead and watched the lanterns pass the new railing.
text.zh: 李大守着桥头的竹料垛，看着灯从新栏杆边过去。

text.en: The bridge was not mended, so Li Da carried the spare bamboo to the lane and built stands for the lanterns.
text.zh: 桥没修成。李大把剩下的竹料挑到夹道，给灯搭了架子。

text.en: Li Da locked the bamboo back in the store. The Li family's lanterns burned only in their own yard.
text.zh: 李大把竹料锁回了库里。李家的灯只在自家院里亮着。

guess_own.en: I wouldn't swear to it, but {hedge} {line}.
{hedge} {line}. That's as far as I'd go.

guess_unknown.en: Don't know who said it, but {hedge} {line}.
It's only talk, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: {teller} told me about it once and said {line}.
I had it from {teller} that {line}.

own.en: As far as I can tell, {line}.
I've thought it over. My view is that {line}.

rival.en: Yet {teller} had a different story: {line}.
rival.zh: 可{teller}那头讲的不同，说{line}。

rival.en: But the word I got from {teller} was that {line}.
rival.zh: 我在{teller}那儿还听见一句，说{line}。

seen.en: {line}. I saw that myself.
{line}, and I had a clear view of it.

unknown.en: The word going round is that {line}.
I heard someone say that {line}. Couldn't tell you who.
unknown.zh: 有人讲过{line}。问谁说的我就不知道了。

lines.en: You're the Manager? I'm Li Da. If you need bamboo from our family, ask me.
lines.zh: 总管是吧？我是李大。要找李家的竹料，问我就行。

lines.en: Mother has asked me twice about what you promised. How's it coming along?
lines.zh: 娘已经问过我两回了，你上回答应的事，眼下办得怎么样？

lines.en: The lanterns go round tonight. The one at our door is my brother's work.
lines.zh: 今晚游灯。我家门口那盏是老二糊的。

lines.en: Now that people know how the bridge broke, Mother doesn't have to keep out of their way.
lines.zh: 桥怎么坏的，总算说清了，娘也不用再躲着人走。

lines.en: Have a look at the new railing. Some of the bamboo I brought over is in there.
lines.zh: 你看新栏杆，里头就有我送来的竹子。

lines.en: What you promised last time, you did.
lines.zh: 上回答应的事，你办到了。

lines.en: I've counted the bamboo by the bridge. If you're still short, give me a number.
lines.zh: 桥边那批竹子我都点过了，要是还缺，你给我个数。

lines.en: I heard you set it straight in front of everyone. My brother needn't take that blame any more.
lines.zh: 听说你当着大伙儿把话说开了，老二也不用白受这口气。

lines.en: You're back. Was there something else last time?
lines.zh: 回来了？上回的话还没说完？

lines.en: Anything else?
lines.zh: 还有什么事？

lines.en: If it's the bamboo you're after, let me speak to my mother before I give you an answer.
lines.zh: 你要是来问竹料，我得先跟我娘商量，再给你回话。

lines.en: Tell me, then. I'm listening.
lines.zh: 你说吧，我听着呢。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo I promised is by the bridge now. Go and count it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 答应你的竹子搁在桥边了，你过去点一点。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo we agreed on is stacked by the bridge, every pole of it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 说好的竹料都码在桥边了，一根不少。

batch_promised.en: You can count on me. I'll carry the bamboo over in the morning and leave it by the bridge.
batch_promised.zh: 你放心，明早我就扛竹子过去，搁在桥边。

batch_promised.en: All you need to do is be there for it. I'll bring the bamboo to the bridge first thing tomorrow.
batch_promised.zh: 你等着收料就是，明早天一亮我就把竹子扛到桥边。

busy.en: I haven't finished this yet. Let's talk once I'm done.
busy.zh: 手上的活还没做完，你等我忙完了再说吧。

busy.en: My hands are full just now. Come back later.
busy.zh: 这会儿腾不出手，你晚点再来。

cannot.en: I can't help there.
That isn't mine to handle.

caught.en: I thought I could take the Manager's word for it. From now on I'll ask around first.
caught.zh: 我想着你是总管，总不会拿瞎话糊弄人，往后我可得多问一声了。

caught.en: You made that up? Then don't come to me again.
caught.zh: 这话是你编的？那以后别来找我。

closed.en: Not now. Come at another time.
closed.zh: 这会儿不行，换个时候来。

closed.en: It's not a good time. Come back in a while.
closed.zh: 现在不方便，过一阵再来。

deal.en: All right. We'll do it that way.

doubted.en: That's not how it was told to me.
doubted.zh: 跟我听来的不一样。

doubted.en: That doesn't square with what I know.
doubted.zh: 这跟我知道的对不上。

elder_no.en: That's not enough yet.
I'm not sure yet. I'll wait and see.

elder_yes.en: I follow you. Let it stand.
What you say is fair. I've no objection.

empty.en: You've got nothing in hand, so that promise doesn't count.
empty.zh: 你手里什么都没有，这话不作数。

empty.en: Just words. I don't believe it.

evade.en: Ask my mother about that.
That's not for me to say.

gift_dislike.en: I don't eat sweet things. Give the {item} to Shitou.
I'm not fond of {item}. Thanks for the thought.

gift_like.en: Some {item}? Now that's good. Thank you.
Good {item}. That's my drink.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. The girl can use it for her lanterns.
Some {item} will do. Thanks.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. No need for more.
The {item} is all counted out. Any more would be too much.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Has that talk been cleared up in public? I haven't heard, so the bamboo stays put.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话当众说清了没有？我没听说，竹子先不动。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: I haven't heard that the talk was cleared up in public. The bamboo stays where it is.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 我没听说那些闲话当众说清了，竹子不能动。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The town is still blaming my brother, and Mother is waiting for you to speak. What will you tell the neighbours, Manager?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上还在怪我家老二，娘等你说句话。总管，你打算怎么跟街坊说？

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Manager, the bamboo is Mother's to lend. She won't agree while that talk is still going round.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 总管，借竹子得先问我娘。外头那些话还没说清，娘不会点头。

hard_other.en: You've had my answer. Leave it.
No. Don't bring it up again.

keeper_no.en: We don't know each other well enough. I can't show you this.
keeper_no.zh: 咱俩还不熟，这个不能给你看。

keeper_no.en: This isn't for outsiders to look at.
keeper_no.zh: 这东西不随便给外人看。

kept_thanks.en: You kept your word, so now I can go home and tell my mother.
kept_thanks.zh: 你把答应的事办了，我也好回去跟我娘说一声。

kept_thanks.en: You kept your word. The family won't forget.
kept_thanks.zh: 你没食言，我们家记着。

knew.en: I'd heard that already.
You needn't tell me that. I know.

needs_nod.en: That's for my mother to decide.
My mother hasn't agreed. I won't touch the bamboo.
needs_nod.zh: 我娘没点头，竹子我不敢动。

not_said.en: I never put it that way.
Who told you that? It didn't come from me.
not_said.zh: 你听谁说的？这话我没讲过。

nothing_to_say.en: I was at home that night. I saw nothing of what happened at the bridge.
nothing_to_say.zh: 那晚我在家，桥那边的事一点没看见。

nothing_to_say.en: I've got nothing to say on it.

objection_withdrawn.en: My mother has given way, and I've nothing against it either.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 我娘松口了，我这边也没话说。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's been made clear. I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 事情说清楚了，我不拦着。

point_heard.en: I only heard {name} mention it in passing. If you want the whole story, ask there.
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}顺口提过这事，真要问明白，你还得找那边。

point_heard.en: Try {name}. I only heard a bit of it.
point_heard.zh: 你找{name}再问问。我就听了几句。

point_hub.en: I don't know. Ask {name}, who hears the news.
point_hub.zh: 我不知道。你去问{name}，那边消息多。

point_hub.en: No use asking me. Ask {name} instead.
point_hub.zh: 这事问我没用，你找{name}打听。

promise_open.en: It's {amount} poles of {item}, at the bridge {when}. I haven't forgotten.
promise_open.zh: {amount}根{item}，{when}送到桥边。我记着呢。

promise_open.en: That batch is promised. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} over {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这批应下了，{when}送{amount}根{item}过去。

said_already.en: I said that before.
I just told you. The answer's the same.

testified.en: I only tell what I saw.
testified.zh: 看见的我才说。

testified.en: I had a good look myself. That's why I'm speaking up.
testified.zh: 我是亲眼看清了才敢开口。

timeout.en: The bamboo isn't counted yet. I have to get back.
timeout.zh: 竹料还没点完，我得回去了。

timeout.en: The work won't wait. That's all for now.
timeout.zh: 活不等人，就说到这儿。

too_late.en: It's too late. Tomorrow morning.
It's dark already. Come in the morning.

took_in.en: So that's what happened. I'll tell Mother when I get home.
took_in.zh: 原来是这么回事，我回去也跟娘说一声。

took_in.en: I follow now. If anyone asks me outside, I'll have an answer.
took_in.zh: 这回我听明白了，出去再有人问，我有话答了。

turned_down.en: I can't say yes to you on that.
We've hardly dealt with each other. I can't agree to that.
turned_down.zh: 咱俩还没打过几回交道，这个我不能答应。

unknown.en: I really don't know.
Nobody's mentioned that to me.

will_ask.en: All right. I'll go and talk to them for you.
Good. I'll pass that along.

will_call.en: All right. I'll go and call people to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去喊人到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll fetch everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去叫大家来祠堂。

will_do.en: All right. Leave it to me.
Good. I'll get it done.

witness_in_public.en: I only say what I saw. I don't know any more than that.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只说我看见的，多的不知道。

witness_in_public.en: As much as I saw, that much I say.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见多少，我说多少。

lines.en: I won't press you about it for now.
lines.zh: 这事我先不催你。

lines.en: Come and see the lanterns tonight.
lines.zh: 晚上来看灯啊。

lines.en: Next time someone asks about the bridge, I've got an answer.
lines.zh: 往后再有人问桥的事，就有话回了。

lines.en: Thanks for speaking up for me.
lines.zh: 谢谢你替我说话啊。

lines.en: See you, Manager.
lines.zh: 回见啊，总管。

lines.en: I'm off to the workshop. The lanterns aren't done.
lines.zh: 我回工坊了，灯还没糊完。

text.en: Li Er's lanterns led the parade. Along the route, nobody brought up the story that Li Er broke the bridge.
text.zh: 李二糊的灯排在游灯队前头。路边再没人提李二弄坏桥的那桩闲话。

text.en: Li Er crossed the bridge with a lantern from the workshop. The neighbours saw and nodded hello.
text.zh: 李二提着自己糊的灯过了桥。街坊看见了，都点头打招呼。

text.en: Li Er walked into the lane with a lantern raised, and people called out greetings all the way.
text.zh: 李二举着灯走进夹道，一路都有人打招呼。

text.en: Li Er carried a lantern too, but at the roadside some still lowered their voices over the broken railing.
text.zh: 李二也提了灯。路边还有人压低声音，议论毁桥的事。

text.en: Li Er stayed in the workshop and put away the unlit lanterns one by one.
text.zh: 李二守在扎灯坊里，把没点的灯一盏盏收了起来。

guess_unknown.en: Can't say who told me, but {hedge} {line}.
I only caught a little, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: If you want to know where I heard it, {teller} told me that {line}.
heard.zh: 你问我从哪儿听来的，我听{teller}讲过，说{line}。

heard.en: I remember how {teller} put it: {line}.

own.en: If you ask me, I'd say {line}.

rival.en: Though {teller} told me something different, that {line}.
rival.zh: 不过{teller}跟我说的又不一样，说{line}。

rival.en: There's another version too. I heard from {teller} that {line}.
rival.zh: 可还有一种讲法，我听{teller}说是{line}。

seen.en: I was there myself and saw that {line}.
{line}, and I was there to see that part myself.

unknown.en: That's what's going round, that {line}.
Some folks say {line}. Who said it first, I couldn't tell you.
unknown.zh: 有人这么讲，{line}。谁讲的我也说不上来。

lines.en: You've come to ask about the bridge, have you? I'm Li Er. Go ahead and ask.
lines.zh: 你是来问石桥的吧？我是李二，有什么话你就问。

lines.en: You said you would... never mind. I'd feel awkward pressing you.
lines.zh: 你说过的事……算了，我也不好意思催。

lines.en: Twelve of tonight's lanterns are mine. Don't let them go out.
lines.zh: 今晚的灯有十二盏是我糊的，可别灭了。

lines.en: Now that people know what happened to the bridge, I can look them in the eye again.
lines.zh: 现在桥的事说清了，我也能抬头见人了。

lines.en: The two families finally sat down to eat. I can stop worrying now.
lines.zh: 两家总算吃上了这桌饭。我这下放心了。

lines.en: You came through for me. I owe you one this time.
lines.zh: 你真把答应我的事办了，我这回可欠你个人情。

lines.en: I went there that night to look for the lantern. You spoke up, or people would still be guessing.
lines.zh: 我那晚本来就是去找灯笼的，要不是你肯开口，大家还不知要猜到几时。

lines.en: Me again?
lines.zh: 又找我？

lines.en: Something more? Go on.
lines.zh: 还有事？你说。

lines.en: I've heard everything the town says. Ask me whatever you like.
lines.zh: 镇上的话我都听见了。你要问什么，尽管问。

lines.en: I'm right here. Say what you need.
lines.zh: 我在这儿呢，有话就说。

asleep.en: Li Er rolls over and goes on sleeping.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. At least I helped a little.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边啦，总算帮上一点忙。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's here. There's hope for the bridge now.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到了，桥这下有指望了。

batch_promised.en: Sure, I'll help carry it to the bridge in the morning.
batch_promised.zh: 行啊，明早我帮着送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: It'll be there tomorrow morning. I won't lose this one.
batch_promised.zh: 明早准到，这回我可不会再弄丢了。

busy.en: My hands are full right now. Give me a minute.
busy.zh: 我手上正忙着呢，你等我一下。

busy.en: Let's talk when I've finished up here.
busy.zh: 等手上的活做完，咱们再聊。

cannot.en: I really can't help with that one.
Can't help with that, sorry.
cannot.zh: 这忙我帮不了，对不住啊。

caught.en: I thought someone was finally speaking straight to me. Why did you lie to me too?
caught.zh: 我还想着总算有人肯好好跟我说话，怎么连你也拿瞎话哄我？

caught.en: You lied to me! And I trusted you.
caught.zh: 你骗我！亏我还信你。

closed.en: Not now. Come back another time.
closed.zh: 这会儿不行，换个时候吧。

closed.en: It's not a good moment. Try later.
closed.zh: 现在不方便，你过会儿再来。

doubted.en: Hang on. The part I heard doesn't match what you said.
doubted.zh: 等等，我听的那一段跟你说的不一样。

doubted.en: That's not the version I heard. Who did you ask?
doubted.zh: 我听来的可不是这一回事，你是跟谁问的？

elder_no.en: That alone doesn't settle it for me.
It's still not quite there.

elder_yes.en: Mm, I get it. Let's go with that.
elder_yes.zh: 嗯，我听明白了。就这样吧。

elder_yes.en: Makes sense. You've convinced me.

empty.en: All talk. Who'd believe that.
Just empty words. I won't fall for it.
empty.zh: 空口白话的，我可不上当。

evade.en: Nobody believes me anyway. Go and ask someone else.
evade.zh: 我说了也没人信，你去问别人吧。

evade.en: Let's leave that one alone.

gift_dislike.en: I've no use for {item}, but thanks all the same.
Ah, {item}... it'd be wasted on me. Give it to someone else.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊……我留着也是浪费，你送别人吧。

gift_like.en: Oh, {item}, perfect. That's just what the lantern shades need.
Good {item}. I'll have to make it last.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? Then I won't say no.
Some {item}. Thanks, I'll share that round.

goods_enough.en: That's plenty of {item}. Any more and I'd feel silly.
goods_enough.zh: {item}够了够了，再送我都不好意思了。

goods_enough.en: The {item} piled at the bridge is plenty.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that talk is cleared up, not one pole can be lent.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话没说清楚，竹子一根都借不出来。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: It has to be cleared up in public first. Otherwise, forget the bamboo.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 得先当众把话说清楚，不然竹子免谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Everyone says I broke the bridge... and you've said nothing either, Manager. So I can't really help.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 大伙都说桥是我弄坏的……总管你也不吭声，这忙我就不好帮了。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: They all say I broke the bridge, and you stay quiet too. How could I say yes now?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 都说桥是我弄坏的，总管也一声不吭。我哪还好意思答应呢？

keeper_no.en: We've only just met. Ask me again when we know each other a little better.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们刚打上照面，等熟了些，你再来问我。

keeper_no.en: That's... not something I show to people I hardly know.
keeper_no.zh: 这个……我不好给不熟的人看。

kept_thanks.en: You saw it through after all. I was afraid I'd made trouble for you.
kept_thanks.zh: 你还真把事办成了，我先前还怕给你添了麻烦。

kept_thanks.en: You've done my family a good turn. I'll remember it.
kept_thanks.zh: 帮了我们家这么个忙，我忘不了。

knew.en: Oh, that. I'd heard already.
I know that one already.

needs_nod.en: I have to ask my mother about that first.
My brother hasn't said yes yet. I can't decide on my own.
needs_nod.zh: 大哥还没点头呢，我不敢做主。

not_said.en: I never said that, you know.
I didn't put it like that.

not_so.en: No, no. You've got it backwards.

nothing_to_say.en: I honestly have nothing to say.
Nothing to tell. Really.

objection_withdrawn.en: So it's finally cleared up. I won't get in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 总算说清楚了，我不拦了。

objection_withdrawn.en: So it was a misunderstanding. Then I won't stand in the way either.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 原来是误会，那我也不挡着啦。

point_heard.en: I just heard {name} mention it in passing. Ask there if you want to get to the bottom of it.
point_heard.zh: 我就听{name}随口提了几句，你真想弄明白，就去问问吧。

point_heard.en: I heard it from {name}. You'll get a better answer there if you have more questions.
point_heard.zh: 我是听{name}说的，后头要问什么，找那边比问我强。

point_hub.en: I can't answer that. Ask {name}, who hears every bit of news.
point_hub.zh: 这我答不上来。你去问{name}，什么消息都听得到。

point_hub.en: I don't know. Try {name}, who sits in the teahouse all day and knows the town's business.
point_hub.zh: 我不知道。{name}整天守着茶馆，镇上的事都清楚。

promise_open.en: I said yes and I haven't forgotten. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} over {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这事我应了，没忘。{when}送{amount}根{item}过去。

promise_open.en: Uh, I promised already. It's {amount} poles of {item}, at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 呃，答应过了呀。{amount}根{item}，{when}到桥边。

said_already.en: I said that just now.
I just told you. It's still the same.

testified.en: If you want what I saw myself, I'll tell you straight.
testified.zh: 你问的是我亲眼看见的，我照实给你说。

testified.en: Ask what I saw and I'll tell you straight.
testified.zh: 你问我看见什么，我就照实说。

timeout.en: The paste will dry. I have to get back.
timeout.zh: 糨糊要干了，我得回去了。

timeout.en: That's the time. I have to go. Talk later.
timeout.zh: 到点了，我得走了。回头再聊啊。

too_late.en: It's too late now. Let's do it tomorrow morning.
too_late.zh: 太晚啦，明天早上再说吧。

too_late.en: It's dark already. Find me tomorrow morning.
too_late.zh: 天都黑了，明早再来找我。

took_in.en: I couldn't make sense of it before. It makes more sense the way you tell it.
took_in.zh: 难怪这事听着蹊跷，照你这么说就顺了。

took_in.en: Right, I'll remember what you just told me.
took_in.zh: 嗯，你刚才说的我记住了。

turned_down.en: That one really won't do. Sorry.
My mother won't give way, so I can't say yes to you.
turned_down.zh: 我娘那边不松口，我不好答应你。

unknown.en: Well, now... I really don't know.
I haven't heard about that one.

will_ask.en: Okay, I'll go and have a word for you.
Right, I'll pass the word.

will_call.en: Okay, I'll go and call everybody to the hall now.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去喊大伙儿到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll go and get people to the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去叫人，都来祠堂。

will_do.en: Sure, leave it to me.
On it. I'll go and do it now.

witness_in_public.en: That night I was only looking for my lantern. I did nothing else.
witness_in_public.zh: 我那晚就是去找灯笼的，别的什么也没干。

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I haven't added a thing.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看到这些，没添油加醋。

lines.en: I'm still waiting on what you promised.
lines.zh: 你答应的事，我还等着。

lines.en: See you at the lanterns tonight, Manager.
lines.zh: 晚上灯会上见，总管。

lines.en: It's out in the open, and I can rest.
lines.zh: 话说开了，我也踏实了。

lines.en: Don't let the work at the bridge slip.
lines.zh: 桥上的活，别误了。

lines.en: Go on, and don't neglect the work.
lines.zh: 去吧，别误了正事。

lines.en: Take care on your way. I won't see you to the door.
lines.zh: 慢着点儿走，老婆子就不送你出门了。

text.en: The Manager's promise went unkept. During the parade Granny Li came out to the door for a moment and went no farther.
text.zh: 总管应下的事一直没办。游灯时李老太只在自家门口站了一会儿。

text.en: Granny Li crossed the Stone Bridge slowly, leaning on a stick. The Manager had kept the promise, and the old woman nodded.
text.zh: 李老太拄着拐杖，慢慢走过了石桥。总管答应的事办到了，老人家点了点头。

text.en: Granny Li crossed the Stone Bridge slowly, leaning on a stick. Shopkeeper Zhou bowed at the far end, and the old woman nodded.
text.zh: 李老太拄着拐杖，慢慢走过了石桥。桥那头的周掌柜拱了拱手，老人家点了点头。

text.en: Granny Li crossed the bridge and chatted a while with Shopkeeper Zhou at the far end.
text.zh: 李老太过了桥，在桥头跟周掌柜说了几句家常。

text.en: Granny Li stood at the bridgehead and looked at the bamboo that the Li house had lent, tied into the railing. The lanterns went by, and the old woman did not cross.
text.zh: 李老太站在桥头，看着李家借出的竹子绑在栏杆上。灯过去了，老人家没有过桥。

text.en: The bridge was not mended, and the bamboo that the Li house had lent still lay by the bridge. Granny Li followed the lanterns along the lane behind the temple.
text.zh: 桥没修成，李家借出的竹料还堆在桥边。李老太跟着灯，从庙后的夹道走了一趟。

text.en: Granny Li walked slowly behind the lanterns along the lane behind the temple.
text.zh: 李老太跟着灯，从庙后的夹道慢慢走了一趟。

text.en: Granny Li looked at the unused bamboo by the bridge and said nothing.
text.zh: 李老太看着桥边那堆没用上的竹料，一句话也没说。

text.en: Granny Li kept the Li family's lanterns at home and did not go to the bridge.
text.zh: 李老太守着李家的灯，没有往桥边去。

guess_own.en: I won't swear to it, but {hedge} {line}.
{hedge} {line}. We'll leave it there for now.

guess_unknown.en: I don't know who started it. {hedge} {line}.
It's just people guessing, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: {teller} brought it up with me and said {line}.
This is all I know. I heard from {teller} that {line}.
heard.zh: 我知道的就这么多。听{teller}说，{line}。

known.en: {line}. Young and old in this town know that.

own.en: I've given it some thought, and I say {line}.

rival.en: But {teller} told me different, that {line}.
rival.zh: 可{teller}跟我讲的不一样，说{line}。

rival.en: Yet what I heard from {teller} was that {line}.
rival.zh: 我听{teller}讲过另一句，说{line}。

seen.en: {line}, and this old woman saw it herself.
seen.zh: {line}，我这个老婆子可亲眼看见了。

seen.en: {line}, and these eyes of mine watched it.

unknown.en: There's talk going round that {line}.
I don't know who started it. What people are saying is that {line}.
unknown.zh: 也不知是谁先传的，说是{line}。

lines.en: Are you the Manager the elder sent to see to the festival? I speak for the Li household. What have you come about?
lines.zh: 族长托你来办灯会的吧？李家的事我能做主，你有什么事就同我说。

lines.en: You haven't done what you promised last time. I've been waiting to hear from you.
lines.zh: 你上回应我的事还没办，老婆子可一直等着你的回话。

lines.en: There you are. The lantern walk is tonight. I hung mine by the door first thing.
lines.zh: 你来了。今晚要游灯，我门口那盏一早就挂好了。

lines.en: Since Shopkeeper Zhou was willing to sit down and eat with us, I've no reason to go on quarrelling.
lines.zh: 周家那个掌柜既肯坐下来跟我们吃饭，老婆子也就没什么好争的了。

lines.en: Everyone knows how the bridge broke now. My family can go out with their heads up again.
lines.zh: 大伙儿现在都晓得桥是怎么坏的，李家人也能抬着头出门了。

lines.en: You did what you promised me. The Li house won't forget it.
lines.zh: 答应我的事你办成了，李家记你的好。

lines.en: My eldest has taken the bamboo to the bridge, every pole of it.
lines.zh: 老大把竹料送到桥边了，一根不少。

lines.en: Now that it's been set straight in front of everyone, I can breathe a little easier.
lines.zh: 那几句话既然已经当众说清了，老婆子也能缓口气了。

lines.en: Something we haven't finished with? Go on, then.
lines.zh: 还有件事没说完？你接着讲。

lines.en: Something more? I'm listening.
lines.zh: 还有事？我听着呢。

lines.en: You've come to see me, Manager. What's on your mind?
lines.zh: 总管来找我，是有什么事要说？

lines.en: Sit down. Take your time.
lines.zh: 坐吧，有话慢慢说。

asleep.en: Granny Li is fast asleep and doesn't hear you.
Granny Li sleeps through your call.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo we promised is at the bridge now. Go and have a look.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 说好送到桥边的竹料已经到了，你去看看。

bamboo_arrived.en: The Li bamboo is there, every pole of it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 李家的竹子送到了，一根不少。

batch_promised.en: Good. My eldest will bring it to the bridge in the morning.
batch_promised.zh: 好，明早叫老大送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: I'll lend the bamboo. It will be at the bridge in the morning.
batch_promised.zh: 竹料我借了，明早送到桥边。

busy.en: I can't stop now. Come back in a while.
busy.zh: 这会儿走不开，你过一阵再来。

busy.en: I have something to see to. Another time.
busy.zh: 我手上有事。回头再说吧。

cannot.en: No use asking me. It's not in my hands.
That's nothing I can lend a hand to.

caught.en: So you thought you could lie to an old woman. How do you expect me to trust you after that?
caught.zh: 原来你拿句瞎话哄老婆子，我往后还怎么信你？

caught.en: So that's what you said to fool an old woman.
caught.zh: 原来你拿这话哄老婆子呢。

closed.en: This isn't a good time. Come at another hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿不方便，换个时辰来吧。

closed.en: This isn't the time. Come back later.
closed.zh: 眼下不是时候。晚些再来。

deal.en: Very well. I'll take you at your word this once.

doubted.en: Hold on. That isn't the story I heard.
doubted.zh: 等等，我听来的可不是这么回事。

doubted.en: That's your account, but I was told something different.
doubted.zh: 你说的是这么回事，可我听见的是另一番话。

elder_no.en: On these few words alone, I can't believe it yet.
elder_no.zh: 光凭这几句，我还不能信。

elder_no.en: It hasn't been said fully. I'll wait and see.

elder_yes.en: I understand it now. Let it be done.
You make sense. I've nothing against it.

empty.en: You can't promise what you haven't got.
empty.zh: 你手里没有的东西，许了也是白许。

empty.en: I've heard plenty of talk with nothing behind it.
empty.zh: 光说不做的话，我听得多了。

evade.en: Don't ask me about that. You'll hear the same answer every time.
evade.zh: 这事你别问我，问我也是这句话。

evade.en: Let it be. I'd rather not speak of it.

gift_dislike.en: I don't touch {item}. Take it back.
Ah, {item}... not at my age. I'll take the thought.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊……我这把年纪不碰了。心意领了。

gift_like.en: Ah, {item}, nice and soft. Just what I like at my age.
Some {item}? That's thoughtful of you. I'll take them.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. Set that down there. Kind of you to think of me.
Some {item}, then. We'll find a use for that at home.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. I won't add more.
goods_enough.zh: 桥边的{item}够用了，我不再添。

goods_enough.en: The {item} is all there. No need to send more.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: If you want the bamboo, you'll have to set that talk straight in front of everyone before the Li family can agree.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 你要借竹料，先当着大伙的面把那些闲话说清，李家才能点头。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Let's leave the bamboo for now. Come back when you've set the story straight in front of everyone.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 借竹料的事先放一放，等你当众把那些话说明白了再来找我。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: You've come for bamboo, but people blame my youngest for the bridge. You haven't said a word for us, Manager. How can I lend it?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 你来借竹，可外头都说桥是老二弄坏的。总管，你连句话都没替我们说，我怎么借？

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The bamboo can wait, Manager. Everyone's blaming my youngest. What will you tell them when they're all there?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 竹料先缓缓。总管，街坊都在怪我家老二，你打算在大伙儿跟前怎么说？

hard_other.en: No. Asking again won't change it.

keeper_no.en: We've met only a few times. I can't show you this.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们才见过几面，这个不能给你看。

keeper_no.en: I don't show that to strangers.
keeper_no.zh: 老婆子不给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you promised. I'll remember that kindness.
kept_thanks.zh: 你把答应的事办了，这份好老婆子记在心里。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you promised. The Li house won't forget it.
kept_thanks.zh: 答应的事你办了。李家不会忘的。

knew.en: I've known that a while.
You needn't tell me. I knew.

needs_nod.en: I can't decide that alone. The elder must be asked first.
needs_nod.zh: 这事老婆子一个人定不了，得先问过族长。

needs_nod.en: Without the elder's nod, I won't say yes.

not_said.en: You didn't hear that from me.
not_said.zh: 这话可不是从我嘴里出去的。

not_said.en: I never said that. I only know this much.
not_said.zh: 这句我可没说过，我知道的就那一点。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, so I've nothing to tell.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这事我没看见，说不出什么。

nothing_to_say.en: I went to bed early that night and saw nothing.
nothing_to_say.zh: 那晚我早早睡了，什么也没瞧见。

objection_withdrawn.en: I take your point about my youngest. Talk to my eldest about the bamboo.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 老二的事，我听明白了。竹料你找老大商量。

objection_withdrawn.en: Now that it's been said plainly in front of everyone, I won't stand in the way of the loan. Go see my eldest.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 这些话既然当众说明白了，借竹子的事我就不拦了，找老大去吧。

point_heard.en: I only heard a few words myself. You'll need to ask {name} for the whole story.
point_heard.zh: 我也是听了几句，若要问前因后果，你得去找{name}。

point_heard.en: I didn't pay it much mind, but {name} mentioned it. Try asking there.
point_heard.zh: 这事我没留心，不过{name}提起过，你不如去问问。

point_hub.en: I don't usually ask about such things. For news of the town, try {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我平日少打听这些，你要问镇上的事，倒可以去找{name}。

point_hub.en: I don't know. People come and go all day at {name}'s, so ask there.
point_hub.zh: 这事我不知道。{name}那儿人来人往，你去问问。

promise_open.en: I gave my word already. It's {amount} poles of {item}, at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我答应过了，{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边。

promise_open.en: We've agreed on it. You'll have {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这笔竹料咱们说定了，{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边。

said_already.en: I've said that already.
I said it once. The answer hasn't changed.
said_already.zh: 说过一遍了，还是那句话。

testified.en: I don't tell tales. I say what I saw.
testified.zh: 老婆子不说虚话，看见什么说什么。

testified.en: All of that I saw with my own eyes.
testified.zh: 这些都是我亲眼见的。

timeout.en: It's getting on. I have to go.
timeout.zh: 时候不早了，我得走了。

timeout.en: We'll leave it there. I have to get home.
timeout.zh: 话先搁这儿吧，我得回去了。

too_late.en: It's late. Come again in the morning.
It's dark now. We'll talk first thing tomorrow.

took_in.en: Now I understand.
took_in.zh: 这样我就听明白了。

took_in.en: Now that you've explained it, I know where things stand.
took_in.zh: 听你这么一说，我这心里就有数了。

turned_down.en: That I can't agree to.
No. I can't say yes to that.

unknown.en: Not a word of it reached me.
That's nothing I know about.

will_ask.en: Good. I'll go and put in a word for you.
I'll carry the word for you.

will_call.en: Good. I'll go and call people to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去叫人到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll gather them all at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去把人都叫到祠堂。

will_do.en: Leave this one with me. I'll see to it.
will_do.zh: 这件事你交给我，我来办。

will_do.en: Good. Leave it with me.

witness_in_public.en: I tell only what I saw, and I add nothing.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只说亲眼看见的，别的不添。

witness_in_public.en: I say as much as I saw.
witness_in_public.zh: 看到多少，我就说多少。

guess_heard.en: {teller} seemed to hint at it, and {hedge} {line}.

guess_own.en: I can't be certain of it, but {hedge} {line}.

guess_unknown.en: I don't remember who said it, but {hedge} {line}.
I only overheard it, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I remember {teller} bringing it up once and saying that {line}.
{line}. That's what {teller} told me.

own.en: I've turned it over and I still think {line}.

rival.en: There's one part that's different. I heard from {teller} that {line}.
rival.zh: 还有个地方不一样，我听{teller}说{line}。

rival.en: But I'd heard {teller} say that {line}.
rival.zh: 不过我记得{teller}还说过，{line}。

seen.en: {line}, that much I can say. I was standing right there.
seen.zh: {line}，这个我敢说，当时我就在旁边。

seen.en: {line}, and I saw it myself.

unknown.en: I heard people saying {line}.
It seems everyone's passing it round, that {line}. Who said it first, I don't know.
unknown.zh: 好像大家都在传，{line}。谁先说的，我也不知道。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. How wonderful.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到桥边啦，太好了。

bamboo_arrived.en: Look, the bamboo has come.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 快看，竹料送来了。

batch_promised.en: Okay. First thing tomorrow it goes to the bridge.
batch_promised.zh: 好呀，明天一早就送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: It'll be there in the morning, don't worry.

busy.en: I'm in the middle of something. Talk later.
busy.zh: 我这会儿正忙，等会儿再说吧。

busy.en: Sorry, I really can't get away right now.
busy.zh: 对不起，现在真的走不开。

cannot.en: I can't help with that one.
Sorry, I can't manage that.

caught.en: I trusted you. It never occurred to me you'd lie to me about that.
caught.zh: 我原先那么信你，哪想到你会拿这话来骗我。

caught.en: I thought you were telling me the truth. Shows what I knew.
caught.zh: 我还当你说的是真的。结果哪。

closed.en: It's not a good time. Come at another time.
closed.zh: 现在不方便，换个时候来吧。

closed.en: Not at the moment. Come back later.
closed.zh: 这会儿不行呢，晚些再来。

doubted.en: That's not what I was told.
doubted.zh: 跟我听说的不一样。

doubted.en: One part sounds different from what I heard. Could you say it again?
doubted.zh: 可我先前听见的有一处不一样，你再说一遍好不好？

elder_no.en: That alone isn't enough.
I... I still can't quite believe it.

elder_yes.en: I see. Let's leave it at that.
You're right. I've nothing against it now.
elder_yes.zh: 你说得对，我没有意见了。

empty.en: Just sweet words. I won't believe them.
empty.zh: 光说好听的，我才不信呢。

empty.en: Without anything to show, I don't believe it.

evade.en: I... I can't really say.
That... you'd better ask someone else.

gift_dislike.en: I don't drink {item}... give it to someone else.
Oh, {item}. I really can't use it. Thank you anyway.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊，这个我真用不上。还是谢谢你。

gift_like.en: Some {item}! Thank you, I was just wishing for some.
For me? I'll take the {item}. I'll make you a lantern to say thanks.
gift_like.zh: 给我的？{item}我收下啦。回头我扎盏灯谢你。

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. I'll take them home and brew some for Granny.
Some {item}, that's nice. Thank you.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge, really.
It's enough already. The {item} is piled up.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Unless that talk is cleared up in front of everyone, we can't lend a single pole.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些话不当众说清楚，竹子一根也不能借。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Granny says it has to be cleared up first.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 奶奶说了，要先把话说清楚。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town says my uncle broke the bridge. You haven't said a word, Manager, so Granny won't lend the bamboo.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上都在说我二叔弄坏了桥。总管一声不吭，奶奶才不肯借竹子呢。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The talk is everywhere, and you keep quiet, Manager. I don't dare say yes.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话传得到处都是，总管一直不吭声。我不敢点头。

keeper_no.en: We've only just met. I don't feel right showing you this yet.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们才认识，我还不大好把这个给你看。

keeper_no.en: I can't just show this to anybody.
keeper_no.zh: 这个不好随便给人看。

kept_thanks.en: You really kept your word. Thank you.
kept_thanks.zh: 你真的说话算数，谢谢你。

kept_thanks.en: I was worrying over what to do. You went and took care of it for me.
kept_thanks.zh: 这事我原先还发愁，不知道怎么办才好，你倒替我办妥了。

knew.en: I knew that ages ago. The whole workshop is talking... never mind, I'll stop.
knew.zh: 这个我早知道啦。坊里都传遍了……算了，不说了。

knew.en: I'd heard about it.

needs_nod.en: I'll have to ask my father first.
Granny hasn't nodded yet. I don't dare say yes.
needs_nod.zh: 奶奶还没点头呢，我不敢答应。

not_said.en: I didn't say that, honestly.
That's not what I meant.

not_so.en: No, it wasn't that way at all.

nothing_to_say.en: I've got nothing to say about that.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这个我真没什么好说的。

nothing_to_say.en: I was at home that night. I didn't see a thing.
nothing_to_say.zh: 那晚我在家，什么也没看见。

objection_withdrawn.en: Now it's cleared up, we won't stop you.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚就好，那我们不拦着了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Wonderful. Granny's nodded too.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 太好了，奶奶也点头啦。

point_heard.en: I really don't know myself, but {name} did mention it. Could you ask there?
point_heard.zh: 我自己是真不知道，倒是听{name}提起过，你去问问好不好？

point_heard.en: I only heard {name} mention it in passing. Why not ask?
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}提起过一点，要不你去问问？

point_hub.en: I'm not sure. Try asking {name}. You might find out that way.
point_hub.zh: 我不大清楚，你去找{name}问问，兴许能问出来。

point_hub.en: I don't know. Go and find {name}, who knows all the town's business.
point_hub.zh: 我不知道呢。去找{name}吧，镇上的事那儿最清楚。

promise_open.en: I said yes already. It's {amount} poles of {item}, {when}.
promise_open.zh: 答应过啦，{when}送{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: I remember. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我记着呢，{when}把{amount}根{item}送去。

said_already.en: I've said so already.
I just told you.

testified.en: All I say is what I saw myself.
testified.zh: 我说的全是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I was standing nearby. If you're asking about then, I can tell you.
testified.zh: 我当时就在旁边，你要问的是那会儿的事，我答得出来。

timeout.en: I've still got lanterns to paste at the workshop. And the paper to cut. I have to go.
timeout.zh: 坊里还有灯面没糊。纸也没裁呢，我得走了。

timeout.en: I can't stay. They're waiting for me at the workshop.
timeout.zh: 不能再聊了，坊里有人等我呢。

too_late.en: It's late. Come back in the morning.
too_late.zh: 天这么晚了，明早再来吧。

too_late.en: It's very late. Shall we talk tomorrow?
too_late.zh: 已经很晚啦，明天再说好吗？

took_in.en: Now that you've told it from the beginning, I understand.
took_in.zh: 听你从头这么一说，我就懂了。

took_in.en: I understand now. If anyone asks me, I'll know what to say.
took_in.zh: 我听明白啦，往后有人问我，我也知道怎么答。

turned_down.en: I'm so sorry. I can't agree to this.
turned_down.zh: 真对不起，这件事我不能答应。

turned_down.en: That... really can't be done.

unknown.en: That... nobody's told me about it.
I haven't heard anything about it.

will_ask.en: All right, I'll put in a word for you.
I'll ask for you.

will_call.en: Okay, I'll go and call everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去叫大家来祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll go and call them. Everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去喊人，都到祠堂来。

will_do.en: Sure, I'll take care of it.
All right, I'll do it right away.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I really don't know anything else.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这么多，别的真不知道。

witness_in_public.en: I only tell what I saw, without adding a word.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只说看见的，一个字也不添。

guess_unknown.en: Who set it going, I can't tell. {hedge} {line}.
guess_unknown.zh: 也不晓得是谁传出来的。{hedge}{line}。

guess_unknown.en: I forget where I heard it, but {hedge} {line}.
guess_unknown.zh: 哪儿听来的也记不清了，{hedge}{line}。

heard.en: I remember {teller} saying that {line}.
I heard this part from {teller}, who said that {line}.
heard.zh: 这句是我听{teller}提起的，说是{line}。

known.en: {line}. The people of the town all know it.

rival.en: But when I heard {teller} speak of it, the account was that {line}.
rival.zh: 不过我听{teller}讲起这事，倒说{line}。

rival.en: The version I heard from {teller} differs a little: {line}.
rival.zh: 只是{teller}讲的略有不同，说是{line}。

seen.en: I was there then and watched as {line}.
{line}. I saw it myself, and I don't lie.

unknown.en: I've heard it said that {line}, too.
unknown.zh: 这话我也听人讲过，说是{line}。

unknown.en: I couldn't tell you who said it. All I heard was that {line}.

asleep.en: The temple keeper is fast asleep.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is at the bridge. The mending should go easier now.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，修桥能顺当些了。

bamboo_arrived.en: The materials are here. That's good news.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料到了，这是好事。

batch_promised.en: Good. It will be at the bridge first thing tomorrow.
It'll be there tomorrow morning without fail.

busy.en: Give me a moment to set this incense in place, and then I'll hear you out.
busy.zh: 您稍等，容我把这炷香插上，再听您慢慢说。

busy.en: The lamps in the shrine still need oil. Come another day, please.
busy.zh: 殿里的灯还没添油，您改日再来吧。

cannot.en: That's more than I can do.
I just keep the temple. I can't help with that.
cannot.zh: 我一个看庙的，帮不上这个。

caught.en: I believed what you told me. Looking back, I should have asked another question.
caught.zh: 我先前信了您的话，如今想来，当时就该多问一声。

caught.en: So you were deceiving me all along. My heart sinks.
caught.zh: 原来您一直在骗我。我心里凉了半截。

closed.en: There's someone praying in the shrine just now. It's not the time to talk.
closed.zh: 这会儿殿里有人上香，不便说话。

closed.en: It isn't convenient now. Please come at another hour.
closed.zh: 眼下不方便，您换个时辰再来。

deal.en: All right. You can count on me.

doubted.en: What I heard differs a little from your account. Where did you hear it?
doubted.zh: 我听到的跟您讲的有点不同，您是在哪儿听的？

doubted.en: That's different from what I heard.
doubted.zh: 这跟我听到的不一样。

elder_no.en: That isn't enough. I'm still uneasy.
elder_no.zh: 这些还不够，我心里还不踏实。

elder_no.en: It's not quite there. Let me think more.

elder_yes.en: Now I understand. As you say, then.
elder_yes.zh: 这下我明白了，就照您说的。

elder_yes.en: What you say is right. I'm at ease now.

empty.en: Empty words I won't take.
Saying isn't enough. It has to be done.

evade.en: I'd best keep that to myself.
Please don't ask me that one.

gift_dislike.en: Some {item}. The temple doesn't touch it. Take it back.
No need for {item}. Heaven knows your kindness.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}就不必了。你的心意，菩萨知道。

gift_like.en: Some {item}, just what the temple needs. Thank you.
I'll take the {item}. That's kind of you.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. I'll keep them for the people who come to burn incense.
Some {item}? Thank you, then.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. No need to send more.
goods_enough.zh: 桥边的{item}够了，不用再送了。

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} already. Keep the rest for something else.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that rumour is cleared up in public, this can't be done.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清，这事办不成。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: It has to be cleared up in public first. Then we can talk about the rest.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 得先当众说清楚，才能谈别的。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour is all over town and you say nothing, Manager. I can't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话满镇都是，总管却一句话不说。这事我不能答应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour hasn't gone and you won't speak, Manager. I can't agree to it.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话还没散，总管也不开口。这个我应不下来。

hard_other.en: That can't be done. Please don't raise it again.
hard_other.zh: 这个使不得，您别再提了。

keeper_no.en: We've only met once. The key can wait.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们才见过一回，钥匙的事以后再说。

keeper_no.en: This key isn't for someone I barely know.
keeper_no.zh: 这钥匙不能随便给不熟的人。

kept_thanks.en: You gave me your word and saw it through yourself. You have my thanks.
kept_thanks.zh: 您既应下这件事，又亲自办妥了，我得好好谢您。

kept_thanks.en: You kept faith. Thank you.
kept_thanks.zh: 您守了信，我谢谢您。

knew.en: The people who come to pray told me that already.
knew.zh: 这事来上香的人早讲过了。

knew.en: I know. You needn't say more.

needs_nod.en: This has to go to the clan elder first.
The elder hasn't said yes, so I daren't agree.

not_said.en: Those aren't my words.
You can't lay those words at my door.
not_said.zh: 这句话不能算到我头上。

not_so.en: No, it wasn't like that. You've got it mixed up.

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see anything, so I can't say.
nothing_to_say.zh: 我没看见什么，说不上话。

nothing_to_say.en: I have nothing to tell about that.

objection_withdrawn.en: It's out in the open. I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 话说开了，我不拦着了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Good, the misunderstanding is cleared. I have nothing more to say.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 误会解开了就好，我没别的话。

point_heard.en: I only heard the outline from {name}. If you want the details, you'd best ask in person.
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}说了个大概，您若要问仔细，还得亲自去一趟。

point_heard.en: I can't say for sure, but {name} did bring it up. You might ask there.
point_heard.zh: 我说不准，倒是{name}提起过，您可去问问。

point_hub.en: I spend most days at the temple. For news of the street, try {name}. The teahouse sees more people.
point_hub.zh: 平日我都在庙里，街上的事您不如问问{name}，茶馆来往的人多。

point_hub.en: It's quiet here and I don't hear much. Go and find {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我这儿清静，听不到什么。您去找{name}吧。

promise_open.en: I don't forget a promise. I'll send {amount} poles of {item} over {when}.
promise_open.zh: 答应过的事不会忘，{when}送{amount}根{item}过去。

promise_open.en: It's agreed already. There'll be {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 已经应下了。{amount}根{item}，{when}到桥边。

said_already.en: I've said this already.
I've said what there is to say.

testified.en: I was there for the part you asked about. I can tell you what I saw myself.
testified.zh: 您问的那段我人在场，能讲的都是亲眼瞧见的。

testified.en: I won't speak of what I didn't see.
testified.zh: 没看见的我不会说。

timeout.en: The incense is nearly burnt down. I must light more.
timeout.zh: 香快烧完了，我得去续上。

timeout.en: It's time. The shrine still needs sweeping.
timeout.zh: 时辰到了，殿里还要打扫。

too_late.en: It's late and the temple gate is closing. Come in the morning.
too_late.zh: 天晚了，庙门要关了。明早再来吧。

too_late.en: It's late at night. We'll talk tomorrow.

took_in.en: Hearing you tell it that way, I can see what happened.
took_in.zh: 听您这么一讲，我就明白是怎么回事了。

took_in.en: Thank you for telling me. Now I know how to answer if anyone asks.
took_in.zh: 承您相告，有人再问我，也好回话了。

turned_down.en: Forgive me, I can't agree to this.
turned_down.zh: 对不住，这件事我不能应。

turned_down.en: I can't agree to that. Please understand.
turned_down.zh: 这个我不能答应，您体谅。

unknown.en: I haven't heard anyone speak of that.
None of the people who come to pray have mentioned it.
unknown.zh: 来上香的人没提过这个。

will_ask.en: Good. I'll go and say a word on your behalf.
I'll take your message to them.

will_call.en: Good. I'll ring the bell and ask everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我去敲钟。请大家都到祠堂来。

will_call.en: I'll tell each house. We'll meet at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去挨家说一声，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Good. I'll take care of it.
I'll do what I can.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I won't make up the rest.
witness_in_public.zh: 我看见的就这些，别的不敢乱说。

witness_in_public.en: As heaven sees me, I only say what I saw.
witness_in_public.zh: 菩萨在上，我只说亲眼看见的。

guess_heard.en: From the bit I heard from {teller}, {hedge} {line}.

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. Keep it in mind for now.
Take this for what it's worth. {hedge} {line}.

guess_unknown.en: No idea who started it. {hedge} {line}.
All I heard was a bit here and there. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I got word from {teller} that {line}.
I heard it straight from {teller} that {line}.

rival.en: That's odd. I heard {teller} say that {line}.
rival.zh: 这就怪了，我听{teller}说过，{line}。

rival.en: But I heard a different account from {teller}, that {line}.
rival.zh: 可我还听{teller}讲过另一句，说是{line}。

seen.en: {line}. I was close enough to see for myself.
I was right beside it, and I saw that {line}.

unknown.en: Some in town say {line}.
Someone said {line}. I didn't ask who started it.
unknown.zh: 听人讲{line}。我没问是谁先说的。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. I'll go and measure it first.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，我先去量一量。

bamboo_arrived.en: Good stock. The lengths are just right.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 好料，长短正合用。

batch_promised.en: Done. The materials will be at the bridge in the morning.
It'll be there in the morning, not one short.

busy.en: I've work in hand. Tell me what you need once I have a moment.
busy.zh: 我手上的活还没做完，你有话等我得空了再讲。

busy.en: Let me finish this pass with the plane.
busy.zh: 这一下先让我刨完。

cannot.en: I can't do that job.
That's past my craft. I can't help.

caught.en: I took it seriously because I trusted you, and you went and told me a lie.
caught.zh: 我信了你的话才当回事，你倒好，拿个假的来糊弄我。

caught.en: That was a lie. And I took you at your word.
caught.zh: 你那话是假的。亏我当了真。

closed.en: I've work in hand just now. Come back in a while.
closed.zh: 这会儿手上有活，过一阵再来。

closed.en: Not now. Try another hour.
closed.zh: 现在不行，换个时辰。

deal.en: Then we'll do as we agreed.

doubted.en: No. What I heard was different.
doubted.zh: 不对，我听来的不是这样。

doubted.en: I heard that part differently. Where did you ask?
doubted.zh: 这段我听的是另一个样，你上哪儿问的？

elder_no.en: This alone isn't enough. It won't stand up.
It doesn't carry enough weight. I can't nod.

elder_yes.en: That's honest talk. I accept it.
That holds up. I'll go with it.

empty.en: Talk with nothing solid in it, I don't believe.
An empty frame won't stand.

evade.en: I only deal in timber.
Better left unsaid.

gift_dislike.en: I don't eat {item}. Just leave them.
Some {item}... not for me. Thanks.

gift_like.en: Some {item}. Good. A drop after work.
Ah, {item}. Just right.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? All right, thanks.
Some {item}. Leave that on the bench.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item}. Every joint is covered.
I've measured the {item} at the bridge, and none is short.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until the rumour is cleared up in public, I can't take this on.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清楚，这活我没法接。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear up the rumour first. Then we'll talk materials.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先把那些闲话说清楚，再谈用料。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is passing the rumour round and you say nothing, Manager. I won't agree.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上都在传那些闲话，总管一声不吭。这事我不应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour stands and you keep quiet, Manager. Good timber or not, I won't lend it.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话还在传，总管又不吭声。木头再好，我也不借。

hard_other.en: That won't do. There's no bargaining.

keeper_no.en: We don't know each other yet. Next time.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们还不熟，下回再说。

keeper_no.en: This isn't for strangers.
keeper_no.zh: 这东西不给生人。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you'd said. I'll feel easier dealing with you from here on.
kept_thanks.zh: 你答应了就照办，往后跟你打交道我也就放心了。

kept_thanks.en: You did a good job. If you need me for anything, ask.
kept_thanks.zh: 这事办得牢靠。有用得着我的地方就说。

knew.en: Heard that one already.
Somebody told me that a while back.
knew.zh: 这个早有人跟我说过了。

needs_nod.en: The elder has to nod first.
Nobody has said yes, so I won't start.

not_said.en: I never said that, on my conscience.
not_said.zh: 这话我没讲过，凭良心说。

not_said.en: Those aren't my words. Don't pin them on me.
not_said.zh: 话不是我的，别安到我头上。

not_so.en: Way off. It wasn't like that.

nothing_to_say.en: That's got nothing to do with timber. I've nothing to say.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这事跟木头不沾边，我没话说。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, so I can't say.

objection_withdrawn.en: It's laid out plainly. I won't block it any more.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 话摆明了，我不再拦着。

objection_withdrawn.en: As long as it's said plainly. I won't hold you up.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚就好，我不卡着你了。

point_heard.en: It wasn't my work, but I heard {name} mention it. You'll find out more if you ask.
point_heard.zh: 这事我没经手，倒听{name}说起过，你去问问就知道。

point_heard.en: I only heard the gist. Ask {name} if you need the rest.
point_heard.zh: 我也只听了个大概，你找{name}再问问。

point_hub.en: I can't help you there. If you want to know what's going on in town, your best bet is {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这方面我帮不上，你想打听镇上的事，去问{name}稳妥些。

point_hub.en: That's beyond me. Ask {name}. People come and go at that teahouse all day.
point_hub.zh: 这个我不懂。你去问{name}，茶馆里人来人往。

promise_open.en: Agreed, and I'll have {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}, cut true.
promise_open.zh: 应下了。{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边，尺寸不差。

promise_open.en: The count is agreed, not one short. It's {amount} poles of {item}, delivered {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说好的数，一根不少。{amount}根{item}，{when}送到。

said_already.en: Once is enough.
I told you just now. Don't make me repeat it.
said_already.zh: 刚才讲过了，别让我重复。

testified.en: What I tell you, I saw myself.
testified.zh: 我讲的都是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I don't speak of what I haven't seen.
testified.zh: 没见过的东西，我不说。

timeout.en: There's timber waiting for the saw. I have to get back.
timeout.zh: 木料还等着下锯，得回去了。

timeout.en: I haven't finished measuring. I'll get on with it.
timeout.zh: 尺寸还没量完，我先忙去了。

too_late.en: It's dark and the work's done for the day. Come in the morning.
too_late.zh: 天黑了，收工了。明早来吧。

too_late.en: No saw or chisel at this hour. Tomorrow.
too_late.zh: 这时辰不动刀锯了，明天吧。

took_in.en: The way you put it, I can see how one thing led to the next.
took_in.zh: 你这么一说，前后的事我就连得上了。

took_in.en: I'll remember what you've just told me.
took_in.zh: 你刚才说的话，我记着了。

turned_down.en: Sorry, I can't take this job.
That won't work. Don't press me.

unknown.en: I never had a hand in it, so I don't know.
Couldn't tell you. I don't know.

will_ask.en: Right, I'll carry the message.
I'll ask next time I run into them.

will_call.en: Right. I'll knock on every door.
will_call.zh: 好，我挨家敲门去叫。

will_call.en: I'll go and call them now. We'll meet at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我这就去叫人，祠堂碰头。

will_do.en: Good, I'll take the job.
I can take that job. I'll get to work on it.
will_do.zh: 这活我能接，回头就动手。

witness_in_public.en: What I saw, I'll say. What I didn't, I won't.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见的我说，没看见的不说。

witness_in_public.en: I'll tell as much as I saw.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见多少说多少。

lines.en: I keep count.
lines.zh: 账我记着。

lines.en: Lanterns tonight.
lines.zh: 晚上看灯。

lines.en: Good. It's settled.
lines.zh: 好。说开就好。

lines.en: Bridge is open. Fewer fares.
lines.zh: 桥通了。坐船的少了。

lines.en: Off you go.
lines.zh: 走吧。

lines.en: Boat's leaving.
lines.zh: 船要开了。

text.en: Boatman He spoke up in the hall and owned that the boat had struck the railing that night. Nobody cursed, and the town only asked Boatman He to pay for the timber.
text.zh: 船夫老何在祠堂里开了口，认了那晚船头撞上栏杆的事。镇上没人骂，只请老何赔了木料钱。

text.en: The flood had washed the railing out, and the boat had nothing to do with it. Nobody asked Boatman He again where the boat had been that night.
text.zh: 栏杆是秋汛冲垮的，跟那条船没关系。再没人问老何那晚去了哪里。

text.en: Nobody suspected Boatman He's boat any more. At first light the ferry went out as usual, and Boatman He said nothing.
text.zh: 没人再疑心老何的船了。老何照旧天一亮就下了水，什么也没说。

text.en: After the bridge reopened, fewer people took the ferry. Boatman He still waited at the landing until dark before putting the oars away.
text.zh: 桥通了，坐船的人少了。老何照旧在渡口等到天黑才收桨。

text.en: The bridge stayed shut and the ferry ran all night. Boatman He took people across boatload by boatload and said nothing.
text.zh: 桥没通，渡船一夜没歇。老何一船一船把人送过了河，什么也没说。

guess_unknown.en: Who said it, no idea. {hedge} {line}.
Just heard it. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: {teller} once mentioned that {line}.
I heard {teller} say {line}.

rival.en: What I heard instead, from {teller}, was that {line}.
rival.zh: 可我听{teller}讲过另一句。{line}。

rival.en: But {teller} said {line}.
rival.zh: {teller}却说{line}。

seen.en: I saw for myself that {line}. I'm sure about that much.
seen.zh: 我亲眼看见{line}，这一点错不了。

seen.en: {line}. That much I saw clearly.

unknown.en: Word is {line}.
Talk going round says {line}.

lines.en: Looking for the ferry? I'm Boatman He. Give me a word if you need to cross.
lines.zh: 你找摆渡的？我叫老何，要过河就跟我说一声。

lines.en: You didn't do what you said. I'll remember.
lines.zh: 你应的事没办。我记着。

lines.en: There's no ferry tonight. If you're looking for me, I'll be out watching the lanterns.
lines.zh: 今晚不摆渡，你要是找我，我也去看灯了。

lines.en: The bridge business. It's settled?
lines.zh: 桥的事，讲清了？

lines.en: Now the families have made peace, people can take the ferry in peace too.
lines.zh: 两家总算和了，坐船的人也能清清静静地过河了。

lines.en: Since the bridge opened, more people go that way, and my boat's gone quiet.
lines.zh: 自打桥通了，走桥的人多，我这条船倒闲下来了。

lines.en: You said it, and you did it.
lines.zh: 你说了，也办了。

lines.en: That talk is settled.
lines.zh: 闲话说清了。

lines.en: The rain's coming down hard. I'm keeping the boat out of the water today.
lines.zh: 雨这么大，今儿这条船先不下水。

lines.en: Here again.
lines.zh: 又来了。

lines.en: Out with it.
lines.zh: 讲。

lines.en: Crossing?
lines.zh: 过河？

lines.en: Be quick.
lines.zh: 有事快讲。

bamboo_arrived.en: Bamboo's here.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹到了。

bamboo_arrived.en: Stock at the bridge.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 桥边有料了。

batch_promised.en: I'll bring it in the morning.
There at first light.

busy.en: Come back once I'm done here.
busy.zh: 等我把手头的事做完，你再来。

busy.en: There's someone waiting on the boat. I can't talk just now.
busy.zh: 船上还有人等着，我这会儿跟你说不了话。

cannot.en: No help from me.
Can't do that.

caught.en: I took you at your word. I won't be so quick to do that again.
caught.zh: 我当你那话是真的，往后可没那么好信了。

caught.en: So you made that up. How am I supposed to trust you now?
caught.zh: 这话原来是你编的，你还让我怎么信你？

closed.en: I'm tied up just now. Come back later.
closed.zh: 这会儿没空，你晚点再来。

closed.en: Give it a while. I'm busy now.
closed.zh: 再等一阵，眼下还顾不上。

doubted.en: Wait. That's different from what I heard.
doubted.zh: 等等，我听来的可不一样。

doubted.en: I heard the story before. It didn't go like that.
doubted.zh: 这话我听人讲过，讲的不是你这个样。

elder_no.en: Not enough.
Not yet.

elder_yes.en: Understood. Fine.
Fair.

empty.en: Empty talk.
Don't believe it.

evade.en: I'd sooner leave that alone. Ask someone else.
evade.zh: 这事我不想讲，你问旁人去。

evade.en: If that's what you're asking, I've nothing to tell you.
evade.zh: 你要问这个，我就没什么跟你讲的了。

gift_dislike.en: Some {item}. Not for me.
Some {item}... no need.

gift_like.en: Some {item}. Good.
Ah, {item}. Taken.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? All right.
Some {item}. Put it in the boat.

goods_enough.en: Enough {item}.
Plenty of {item} at the bridge.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Rumour's not cleared. No talk.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 话没说清。不谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear it in public first.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先当众说清。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Everyone's talking. You say nothing. No lending.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 都在传。你不吭声。不借。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: You won't speak, I won't lend.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 你不开口，我不借。

keeper_no.en: We've only met a few times. I can't show you yet.
keeper_no.zh: 你我拢共才见了几回，这会儿还不便给你看。

keeper_no.en: Ask me again when we know each other better.
keeper_no.zh: 等咱们熟了些，你再来问吧。

kept_thanks.en: You did just what you said you would. I'll remember that.
kept_thanks.zh: 你答应了就真去做，我记着呢。

kept_thanks.en: I thought I'd be waiting a while yet. You've already done it.
kept_thanks.zh: 我还当要再等一阵，没想到你已经办妥了。

knew.en: Knew it.
Known.

needs_nod.en: That's the elder's to decide.
Not mine to say.

not_said.en: Never said it.
Not my words.

nothing_to_say.en: Didn't see it.
Nothing.

objection_withdrawn.en: That's clear. I'll give way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说开了。我让步。

objection_withdrawn.en: Fine. Go ahead.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 行。过吧。

point_heard.en: I heard {name} mention it once. I didn't get the whole story, so ask there.
point_heard.zh: 这事{name}提过一回，我没听全，你得去问清楚。

point_heard.en: I heard it from {name}. Ask there for the rest.
point_heard.zh: 我是听{name}提起的，剩下的你去问吧。

point_hub.en: How would I know all that? If you want the town's news, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我哪晓得这许多？要打听镇上的事，你问{name}。

point_hub.en: Don't deal in gossip. See {name}.
point_hub.zh: 不管闲话。找{name}。

promise_open.en: Promised it. Bringing {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 应了。{when}，{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: Said so. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说过。{when}送{amount}根{item}。

said_already.en: Said it.
Told you.

testified.en: I was close by. I've told you everything I saw.
testified.zh: 那会儿我在跟前，见到什么我都说了。

testified.en: Saw it myself.
testified.zh: 亲眼见的。

timeout.en: I've got to go. Tell me the rest next time.
timeout.zh: 我得走了，你还有话下回再说。

timeout.en: I've got a boat to look after. Let's leave it there.
timeout.zh: 我还得照看那条船，就说到这儿吧。

too_late.en: Late. Morning.
Dark. Tomorrow.

took_in.en: I'll keep that in mind.
took_in.zh: 这事我记得了。

took_in.en: Right, I see what you mean now.
took_in.zh: 成，这下我听懂了。

turned_down.en: Won't agree.
No go.

unknown.en: Don't know.
Never heard it.

will_ask.en: I'll tell them.
I'll pass it on.

will_call.en: I'll fetch them.
will_call.zh: 我去叫人。

will_call.en: Hall. I'll call them.
will_call.zh: 祠堂。我去喊。

will_do.en: I'll go.
On it.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw.
witness_in_public.zh: 就看见这些。

witness_in_public.en: Saw nothing else.
witness_in_public.zh: 别的没见。

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. Don't tell anyone I said it.

guess_unknown.en: Somebody said so. {hedge} {line}.
I forgot who said it. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: It was {teller} who told me that {line}.
Well, I heard {teller} say {line}.

rival.en: But I heard it another way. I heard {teller} say {line}.
rival.zh: 可是{teller}说{line}。

rival.en: But when I asked {teller}, I heard that {line}.
rival.zh: 可我问过{teller}呀，那时候听见说{line}。

seen.en: {line}. I saw it clear as anything.
{line}. I really saw it!

unknown.en: I heard someone say {line} once.
I heard that {line}. I didn't ask who said it first.
unknown.zh: 有人讲{line}。我没问谁先说的。

asleep.en: Shitou is still asleep and doesn't stir.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's here, at the bridge!
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到啦，在桥边！

bamboo_arrived.en: Lots of bamboo. The bridge can be fixed now.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 好多竹子，桥能修啦。

batch_promised.en: Okay. It'll be at the bridge tomorrow morning.
Pinky promise. It'll be there tomorrow morning.

busy.en: I'm in the middle of a game. Just wait a bit.
busy.zh: 我正玩到一半呢，你等我一下就好。
