busy.en: Don't bother me. I'm playing.
busy.zh: 别烦我，我正玩着呢。

cannot.en: I can't do that.
I can't.

caught.en: I believed you just now. You lied to me!
caught.zh: 我刚才还信了你的话，原来你骗我！

caught.en: You still want me to believe you?
caught.zh: 你还想让我信你啊？

closed.en: Not now. Wait a bit.
closed.zh: 现在不行，等一会儿。

closed.en: Not now. Come back after a while.
closed.zh: 不是现在啦，过会儿再来。

doubted.en: Nope. That's not what I heard.
doubted.zh: 不对，我听的不是这样。

doubted.en: That's not what I heard. Can you say it again?
doubted.zh: 可我听到的不是这句呀，你再说一遍？

elder_no.en: Still not enough. I don't believe it.
I didn't get it.

elder_yes.en: I get it now. That's that.
Oh. In that case, I believe you.

empty.en: You haven't given me anything. Fibber.
All you do is talk. I don't believe it.

evade.en: I'm not telling.
Won't tell you!

gift_dislike.en: Some {item}... they taste bitter. I don't want them.
Those {item} are for grown-ups. Give them to Granny.

gift_like.en: Some {item}! For me? Really?
Some {item}, my favourite.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? I'll take it home to my dad.
Some {item}? I'll take it home, then.

goods_enough.en: There's so much {item} at the bridge. Enough.
No more. That's enough {item}.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Granny said so. Until that talk is cleared up, no bamboo at all.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 奶奶说了。那些话不说清楚，竹子一根都不借。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: It has to be cleared up in front of everybody, or no bamboo.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 要当着大家说清楚，不然没有竹子。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Everybody says my uncle broke the bridge, and you don't say a thing. Not lending!
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 大家都说我二叔弄坏了桥，你也不说话。不借！

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Uncle Er didn't break the bridge! Why don't you say anything?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 二叔才没弄坏桥！你为什么不说话？

keeper_no.en: I don't even know you. Why should I show you?
keeper_no.zh: 我又不认得你，怎么能给你看呀？

keeper_no.en: Granny says not to show strangers.
keeper_no.zh: 奶奶说不能给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: You said you'd do it, and you did. I'll believe you next time too.
kept_thanks.zh: 你说会办就真办了，下回我还信你。

kept_thanks.en: You really did it!
kept_thanks.zh: 你真的做到啦！

knew.en: I knew that ages ago.
I know that too.

needs_nod.en: I have to ask Granny first.
If Dad doesn't nod, I can't say yes.

not_said.en: I never said any such thing!
It wasn't me who said it.

not_so.en: No, no. It's not like that.

nothing_to_say.en: I never saw a thing.
I was asleep that night. Really.

objection_withdrawn.en: It's all cleared up. I won't stop you now.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚啦，那我不拦了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Granny isn't stopping you, so I won't either.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 奶奶不拦了，我也不拦。

point_heard.en: I only heard {name} mention it once. Go ask there.
point_heard.zh: 这我也说不好，我就听{name}提了一回，你自己去问嘛。

point_heard.en: I heard it from {name}. If you want to know, go ask there.
point_heard.zh: 是{name}跟我讲的，你要问去问那边嘛。

point_hub.en: Don't ask me. If you want to know what's happening in town, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 你问我没用呀，镇上有什么事，你去问{name}。

point_hub.en: For grown-up stuff, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 大人的事，去问{name}。

promise_open.en: I said yes already. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我答应啦，{when}送{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: We pinky-promised already. It's {amount} poles of {item}, at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 拉过钩啦。{amount}根{item}，{when}到桥边。

said_already.en: I already told you!
I just said it.

testified.en: I really saw it. Cross my heart.
testified.zh: 我真的看见了，骗你是小狗。

testified.en: I was right there when it happened. I saw it myself.
testified.zh: 我那会儿就在边上，自个儿看到的。

timeout.en: I have to go home for dinner.
timeout.zh: 我要回家吃饭了。

timeout.en: Teacher's waiting for me to recite. I'm off.
timeout.zh: 先生等着我背书呢，我走啦。

too_late.en: It's dark. Come tomorrow.
It's too late. I'm going to bed.

took_in.en: Oh, now I get it!
took_in.zh: 哦，这下我听懂啦！

took_in.en: So that's what you mean. I'll remember.
took_in.zh: 你说的是这回事，我记住了。

turned_down.en: No way. I won't.
Sorry, that's not allowed.

unknown.en: Dunno.
I really haven't heard.

will_ask.en: Okay, I'll go and tell them.
Okay, I'll go and ask.

will_call.en: I'll go call everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去喊大家来祠堂。

will_call.en: Okay, I'll run and get people.
will_call.zh: 好，我跑着去叫人。

will_do.en: Okay, I'll go.
All right, then. Let me do it.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I didn't see anything else.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这些，别的没看到。

witness_in_public.en: I say what I saw. I'm not lying.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见啥说啥，我没骗人。

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. I'll have to look into it.

guess_unknown.en: I haven't found who said it, but {hedge} {line}.
It's only street talk. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I heard {teller}'s account in person. It was that {line}.
I heard from {teller} that {line}. It still needs checking.
heard.zh: 我听{teller}讲过，说{line}。这还得核一核。

known.en: {line}. There's nobody in town who doesn't know it.
{line}. It's known to everyone in town.

own.en: From what I know of the matter, {line}.
own.zh: 依我手头知道的情形看，{line}。

own.en: I've thought it through, and I believe {line}.

rival.en: I heard a different account from {teller}, namely that {line}.
rival.zh: 我还听{teller}讲过另一种说法，说是{line}。

rival.en: There's another account to check. I heard {teller} say {line}.
rival.zh: 还有一条得对一对。{teller}说{line}。

seen.en: I happened to be there and saw for myself that {line}.
seen.zh: 那时我恰在场，亲眼看见{line}。

seen.en: I was present at the time and saw that {line}.
seen.zh: 那时我人在场，亲眼见到{line}。

unknown.en: There's a story going round town that {line}.
I haven't found who said it. The account I heard was that {line}.
unknown.zh: 这话还没查出是谁说的，说{line}。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is at the bridge. At last the work can start.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，桥总算能动工了。

bamboo_arrived.en: There's bamboo at the bridge now, so the mending has a chance.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 桥边有了竹料，修桥有望了。

batch_promised.en: I've said yes. It will reach the bridge tomorrow morning.
batch_promised.zh: 我答应了，明早送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: It will be there tomorrow morning. I can promise you that.
batch_promised.zh: 明早一定送到，这个我可以担保。

busy.en: I've a little more of the Town Gazette to proofread. Please let me finish it first.
busy.zh: 这期《镇报》还差一点没校完，您容我先把手头的事做了。

busy.en: The pupils are reading and I can't leave them.
busy.zh: 学生在念书，我走不开。

cannot.en: I'm afraid I can't help with that.
I can only teach and write. I can't do this.
cannot.zh: 我只会教书写字，这个办不了。

caught.en: If I'd printed what you said in the Gazette without checking, wouldn't I have passed the lie on myself?
caught.zh: 我若信了您刚才的说法，稀里糊涂往报上一登，岂不连我也成了传假话的人？

caught.en: You lied to me. From now on I'll check what you say before I believe it.
caught.zh: 你骗了我。往后你的话，我得先查过再信。

closed.en: I'm teaching now. Please come at another hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿在上课，请换个时辰再来。

closed.en: It isn't convenient just now. Let's talk later.
closed.zh: 眼下不方便，晚些再谈。

deal.en: Good. We'll do it like that.

doubted.en: I heard a different account before. Could you tell me whom you asked?
doubted.zh: 我先前听的说法不同，能请您讲讲问的是谁吗？

doubted.en: The two accounts differ. That part still needs checking.
doubted.zh: 两种说法有出入，这一处还要再查。

elder_no.en: On these few words alone, no conclusion can be drawn.
elder_no.zh: 单凭这几句，还难下定论。

elder_no.en: The reasons aren't enough yet. I won't believe it lightly.
elder_no.zh: 理由还不够，我不敢轻信。

elder_yes.en: That makes sense. It fits what we know, point by point.
elder_yes.zh: 说得通。拿这些事一件件对，也都对得上。

elder_yes.en: You've explained it. I have no objection.
elder_yes.zh: 您讲明白了。我没有异议。

empty.en: There's nothing behind that, so I can't believe it.
Words without proof don't go in the Gazette, and I don't believe them either.
empty.zh: 没凭据的话报上不登，我也不信。

evade.en: This hasn't been checked yet, so I won't speak loosely about it.
evade.zh: 这事还没查实，在下不好乱讲。

evade.en: I don't repeat what hasn't been looked into.
evade.zh: 没查清楚的事，我不往外说。

gift_dislike.en: I don't drink {item}. But I accept the thought.
Better give the {item} to someone else. Thank you all the same.

gift_like.en: Ah, {item}, just to my taste. My thanks.
Some {item}? You're too kind. I accept with thanks.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. That's thoughtful.
Some {item}, then. The pupils can share them.

goods_enough.en: The {item} at the bridge is already enough.
There's enough {item}. No need to add more.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: So long as the rumour stands uncleared in public, this is not up for discussion.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 谣言一天不当众澄清，这事就一天不谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear up the rumour in public first. Then we can talk it over.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先当众把谣言说清楚，再来商量。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour has gone all round town and you haven't said a word, Manager. I can't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 谣言传遍了全镇，总管却一句话不说。这事我不能答应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour hasn't been cleared and you won't speak, Manager. I won't agree lightly.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 谣言没说清，总管也不开口。我不敢轻易应下。

hard_other.en: There's no room to bargain on this.
There's nothing more to discuss on that.

keeper_no.en: We've only just met. That can wait.
keeper_no.zh: 你我刚认识，这个以后再说。

keeper_no.en: I don't show that to people lightly.
keeper_no.zh: 这东西我不轻易给人看。

kept_thanks.en: Now that you've kept your word, I wanted to thank you the next time we met.
kept_thanks.zh: 您把答应的事办成了，我想着下回遇见您，总该当面道一声谢。

kept_thanks.en: What you promised got done. Thank you.
kept_thanks.zh: 答应的事办到了，多谢。

knew.en: I had already heard about it.
I know. Someone told me before you did.
knew.zh: 这个我知道，前头已经有人跟我讲过。

needs_nod.en: This must go to the clan elder first.
The elder hasn't agreed, and it's not for me to decide alone.
needs_nod.zh: 族长没点头，我不好自作主张。

not_said.en: That differs from what I said. Who passed it on to you?
not_said.zh: 这句话与我说过的有出入，您是听谁转述的？

not_said.en: I never said it that way.

not_so.en: That's not so. You have it wrong.
That account doesn't square with the facts.

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, so I can't tell you anything.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这件事我没看见，说不上什么。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, and I won't guess.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这事我没见着，不好乱说。

objection_withdrawn.en: Since the matter has been made clear, I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 事情既然说明白了，我不再阻拦。

objection_withdrawn.en: That misunderstanding's been cleared up. I can let it go now.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 这个误会已经解开了。我可以放心了。

point_heard.en: I heard a little from {name}. As I don't know the whole story, you might ask in person.
point_heard.zh: 我从{name}那里听见几句，原委尚不清楚，您不妨亲自去问一问。

point_heard.en: I only heard {name} mention it. You might ask for the full account there.
point_heard.zh: 我也只听{name}提过，您不妨问问原委。

point_hub.en: I haven't looked into that. If you want to know how it came about, try asking {name} first.
point_hub.zh: 这事我还没细问，您若想弄清来龙去脉，可以先去找{name}。

point_hub.en: I won't guess. If you want the talk of the street, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我不敢乱说。想打听街坊的事，可以去问{name}。

promise_open.en: I've already given my word. It's {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我已经答应了，{when}把{amount}根{item}送到桥边。

promise_open.en: This was agreed earlier. I'll deliver {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这件事早就应下了，{when}交{amount}根{item}。

said_already.en: I said that a moment ago.
I made that clear before, and I won't repeat it.
said_already.zh: 前面已经讲清楚了，不再重复。

testified.en: Everything I tell you, I saw myself.
testified.zh: 在下说的都是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I don't talk about what I haven't seen.
testified.zh: 没亲眼见过的，我不乱说。

timeout.en: The pupils are waiting for their lesson. I must go back.
timeout.zh: 学生还等着上课，我得回去了。

timeout.en: It's time. I haven't finished writing for the Gazette.
timeout.zh: 时辰到了。报上的稿子还没写完。

too_late.en: It's late. Please come back in the morning.
It's too late in the day. We'll talk tomorrow.

took_in.en: I see. I'll note it down.
took_in.zh: 原来如此，我记下了。

took_in.en: Thank you for coming to tell me. I've noted what you said.
took_in.zh: 多谢相告，您刚才说的我记下了。

turned_down.en: I'm sorry, I can't agree to this.
I'm afraid I must decline.
turned_down.zh: 这个请求，恕在下不能从命。

unknown.en: Nobody has spoken to me about this.
Nobody's sent this in to the paper.
unknown.zh: 还没人往报上递过这件事。

will_ask.en: Very well. I'll go and explain it for you.
I'll pass your words on.

will_call.en: Very well. I'll go and ask everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去请大家到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll send the pupils round every house with the message. We'll meet at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我让学生们挨家去报个信，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Very well, I'll see to it.
Yes, leave it to me.

witness_in_public.en: I tell only what I saw, not a word more or less.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只说看见的，一个字不增不减。

witness_in_public.en: What I saw ends there. I don't know the rest.
witness_in_public.zh: 我看见的就到这里，其余的不知道。

guess_heard.en: I heard it from {teller}, but I don't remember well. {hedge} {line}.

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. I can't think of anything else.

guess_unknown.en: Can't remember who said it. {hedge} {line}.
I only heard a bit. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: {teller} told me about it and said {line}.
{line}. I heard that from {teller}.

own.en: I've been thinking about it, and I think {line}.

rival.en: But I heard {teller} tell it this way: {line}.
rival.zh: 可{teller}跟我说过，{line}。

rival.en: But {teller} told it differently and said that {line}.
rival.zh: 可是{teller}讲的不一样，说{line}。

seen.en: {line}, and I really did see it myself.
{line}, and I was close enough to see.

unknown.en: I think someone said {line}.
I heard somebody say {line}.

bamboo_arrived.en: There's bamboo at the bridge now.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 桥边有竹子了。

bamboo_arrived.en: There's a new pile of bamboo by the river.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 河边多了一堆竹子。

batch_promised.en: Okay. It goes tomorrow morning.
It'll be at the bridge when it gets light.

busy.en: Don't come any closer just yet. I'm fishing, and footsteps will scare them away.
busy.zh: 你先别过来，我还在钓鱼，脚步重了鱼就跑了。

busy.en: Wait a moment. I saw the float move.
busy.zh: 你等一下嘛，我看见浮子在动了。

cannot.en: I don't know how.
I can't help you.

caught.en: I thought it was true. Why did you lie to me?
caught.zh: 我还当你说的是真的，你怎么骗我呀？

caught.en: You fooled me once. I'm not listening next time.
caught.zh: 你都骗过我一回了，我下次就不听你的了。

closed.en: Not now. Later.
closed.zh: 现在不要。等一下。

closed.en: I'm watching my float. Later on.
closed.zh: 我在看浮子。晚点。

doubted.en: What I heard was different.
doubted.zh: 我听到的不一样。

doubted.en: Wait. That's not what I heard from the others.
doubted.zh: 等等，可我听别人说的不是这样呀。

elder_no.en: Not enough yet.
I still don't believe it.

elder_yes.en: I understand.
You're right.

empty.en: Just saying doesn't count.
I don't believe you.

evade.en: I'm sleepy...
I don't want to say.

gift_dislike.en: Some {item}... bitter. I don't like tea.
Some {item}... tea keeps me awake. No, thanks.

gift_like.en: Some {item}... for me? Thank you.
Some {item}. I'll save them for fishing tonight.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? I'll take it, then.
Some {item}... I'll take it home.

goods_enough.en: There's lots of {item} at the bridge.
That's enough {item}, isn't it? The bank's piled full.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: The rumour has to be cleared first. Or no.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些话要先说清楚。不然不行。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: The grown-ups say it's no good till the rumour's cleared.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 大人说，那些话不说清楚就不行。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Everyone's talking about it. You never say anything. No.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 大家都在说。你一直不说话。不行。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour's everywhere. You stay quiet. I won't.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 到处都在说那些话。你不出声。我不答应。

keeper_no.en: I don't know you.
keeper_no.zh: 我不认识你。

keeper_no.en: Mum says don't show strangers.
keeper_no.zh: 娘说不给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: You really did it. I knew you'd keep your word.
kept_thanks.zh: 你真把那件事办好了，我就知道你说话算数。

kept_thanks.en: I thought it'd take ages, and you've done it already.
kept_thanks.zh: 我还以为得等好久呢，你已经办好了呀。

knew.en: I know that.
I knew already.

needs_nod.en: I have to ask my mum.
Mum won't let me.

not_said.en: I didn't say that.
That's not how I said it.

not_so.en: No, that's not what I saw.
not_so.zh: 不对，我看见的不是这样。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see anything.
Nothing. Really.

objection_withdrawn.en: It's cleared up. I won't stop you.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚了。我不拦你。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's all right now. Go on.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 现在没事了。你去吧。

point_heard.en: I didn't see it. I only heard {name} mention it, so ask there.
point_heard.zh: 我没看见这事，只听{name}提过，你还是去那儿问吧。

point_heard.en: I heard it from {name}. Why don't you ask there?
point_heard.zh: 我听{name}说过，你要不要去问问？

point_hub.en: How would I know? You could ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我哪知道这些？你去问问{name}吧。

point_hub.en: I was asleep and didn't hear anything. Go and find {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我在睡觉，什么也没听到。你去找{name}。

promise_open.en: I promised already. It's {amount} poles of {item}, {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我答应过了。{when}，{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: It's settled. I'll take {amount} poles of {item} to the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说好了的，{when}拿{amount}根{item}去桥边。

said_already.en: I already said.
You asked already.

testified.en: That's what I saw.
testified.zh: 我看见的就是这样。

testified.en: I was right there. What do you want to ask?
testified.zh: 我当时就在旁边，你要问什么呀？

timeout.en: I'm sleepy. I'm going home to sleep.
timeout.zh: 我困了，要回去睡了。

timeout.en: I'm about to get a bite.
timeout.zh: 鱼快咬钩了。

too_late.en: It's really late. Come tomorrow.
I'm going to sleep. Tomorrow.

took_in.en: Oh, I think I understand now.
took_in.zh: 哦，我这下想明白了。

took_in.en: I'll remember what you just told me.
took_in.zh: 你说的这个我记住了。

turned_down.en: No. I won't.
Sorry, no.

unknown.en: I didn't see.
Nobody told me.

will_ask.en: Okay, I'll ask.
I'll go and tell them.

will_call.en: Okay, I'll call everyone.
will_call.zh: 好，我去叫大家。

will_call.en: I'll run and call people to the hall.
will_call.zh: 我跑去祠堂喊人。

will_do.en: Okay, I'm going.
I'll do it.

witness_in_public.en: I only saw this much by the river.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只看到河边这些。

witness_in_public.en: I didn't see anything else.
witness_in_public.zh: 别的我没看见。

guess_unknown.en: Nobody can say where it came from. {hedge} {line}.
Who said it, I couldn't tell you. {hedge} {line}.
guess_unknown.zh: 听来的话没说是谁讲的，{hedge}{line}。

heard.en: I heard {teller} mention in passing that {line}.
{line}. That's the account I got from {teller}.

own.en: I've puzzled over it, and I think {line}.

rival.en: What {teller} told me was a little different: {line}.
rival.zh: {teller}跟我说的不大一样，说{line}。

rival.en: I also heard another version from {teller}, who said that {line}.
rival.zh: 我还听{teller}讲了个不同的说法。{line}。

seen.en: I happened to be standing nearby and saw that {line}.
seen.zh: 那会儿我刚好在边上，瞧见{line}。

seen.en: {line}. I was right beside it and saw it clearly.

unknown.en: I've heard people say that {line}.
I heard someone say in passing that {line}.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's here. Save me a few poles once the bridge is done.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到了。修完桥剩下的，给我留几根。

bamboo_arrived.en: It's all at the bridge. That's a weight off my mind.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料都到桥边了，这下放心了。

batch_promised.en: Done. It goes to the bridge tomorrow morning, and the lanterns are waiting on it.
batch_promised.zh: 成。明早就送到桥边，灯还等着用呢。

batch_promised.en: It'll be there first thing tomorrow, and the lantern work won't lose a minute.
batch_promised.zh: 明天一早送到，扎灯一点不耽误。

busy.en: The paste hasn't dried through. I need to stay with the paper a little longer.
busy.zh: 糨糊还没干透，这灯面离不得人，你等我一会儿。

busy.en: I'm pasting a lantern face. Let me finish this sheet.
busy.zh: 我正糊灯面呢，等我糊完这一张。

cannot.en: I can't help with that. My hands are full of lanterns.
cannot.zh: 这忙我帮不上，手里全是灯。

cannot.en: I can't manage that. Sorry.

caught.en: I believed you at the time. I didn't think you'd try to fool me with a lie.
caught.zh: 我先前还信了你那番话，没想到你也会拿假的来哄人。

caught.en: You made it up? And I fell for it.
caught.zh: 你编的？还真给你哄住了。

closed.en: The workshop's too busy just now. Come later.
closed.zh: 坊里这会儿顾不上，晚些来。

closed.en: Not now. Come back once this batch of lanterns is pasted.
closed.zh: 现在不行，等这批灯糊好再来。

deal.en: Settled then. I'll do my part.
All right, it's settled. See you at the festival.

doubted.en: What I heard had it another way.
doubted.zh: 我听来的不是这个样。

doubted.en: That part doesn't fit what I heard. Where did you get it?
doubted.zh: 这一段跟我听来的对不上，你是从哪儿听的？

elder_no.en: On this alone, it doesn't make sense yet.
I haven't got it straight yet. Give me time.

elder_yes.en: Clearly put. I'm convinced.
I see what you mean now.
elder_yes.zh: 你这么一讲，这事我懂了。

empty.en: Talk without binding a lantern gives no light.
empty.zh: 光说不扎，灯是不会亮的。

empty.en: You've nothing in hand. I won't believe mere talk.
empty.zh: 手里什么都没有，光说我不信。

evade.en: I'm busy here. The lanterns come first.
I keep out of the two families' business. Don't ask me.
evade.zh: 两家的事我不掺和，别问我。

gift_dislike.en: I've no use for {item}. Lanterns don't drink.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}我这儿用不上，灯可不喝这个。

gift_dislike.en: I don't touch {item}. Lantern work needs a steady hand. Thank you all the same.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}我不沾，扎灯得手稳。心意我领了。

gift_like.en: Oh, {item}. Just what I can use.
For me? I'll take the {item}. Thank you.
gift_like.zh: 给我的？{item}我收下了，谢谢你。

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. Put them here, I'll eat once I'm done.
Some {item}, that's kind. Thank you for thinking of me.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. Don't add more.
The {item} is enough, so keep the rest for lanterns.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until the rumour is cleared up in public, I won't help with this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话没当众说清楚，这事我不帮。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until the rumour is cleared, I can't even make lanterns in peace.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 闲话不先说清楚，灯都扎不安心。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is passing that rumour round and you say nothing. I won't help.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上都在传那些闲话，你却一声不吭。这忙我不帮。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour is still going round and you keep quiet, Manager. I can't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话还在传，总管也不出声。这事我没法答应。

hard_other.en: Put that out of your head.

keeper_no.en: We don't know each other. Come again some time.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们不熟，下回再来吧。

keeper_no.en: What's in the workshop isn't for strangers.
keeper_no.zh: 工坊里的东西不给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: I thought the trouble wasn't over yet, and you've already seen it through. I'll remember what you did for me.
kept_thanks.zh: 我原想着这事还得劳你费心，你倒已经办成了，我记着你的好。

kept_thanks.en: You got everything done as promised. I appreciate it.
kept_thanks.zh: 答应我的事都办妥了。劳你费心。

knew.en: I heard about it a while back.
I knew that already. It's all round the workshop.
knew.zh: 这个我早知道了，坊里都传遍了。

needs_nod.en: Festival business needs the elder's nod.
The elder hasn't spoken yet, so I can't move on it.
needs_nod.zh: 族长还没发话，我这儿不好动。

not_said.en: I never said anything of the sort.
Those aren't my words, really.

not_so.en: That's wrong. It didn't go that way.
not_so.zh: 错了，事情不是这么回事。

nothing_to_say.en: I was busy pasting lanterns and saw nothing.
nothing_to_say.zh: 我只顾着糊灯，什么也没瞧见。

nothing_to_say.en: A lantern doesn't talk, and I've nothing to say either.
nothing_to_say.zh: 灯不会说话，我也没什么好说。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's cleared up. I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清了，我不拦了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Good that it's cleared up. The festival is what matters.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚就好，灯会要紧。

point_heard.en: I heard of it from {name}. We were busy at the workshop and I didn't catch much, so ask there.
point_heard.zh: 听{name}讲过这事，不过坊里那会儿忙，我没留心，你还是去问问吧。

point_heard.en: I caught only part of it. You'd better ask {name}.
point_heard.zh: 我只听了半截，你到{name}那儿问问吧。

point_hub.en: I know what goes on in the workshop, but I don't hear much of the town's talk. Try asking {name}.
point_hub.zh: 坊里的事我倒知道，镇上传些什么我听得少，你可以去问{name}。

point_hub.en: I can't answer that. Folk come and go at the teahouse, so ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这个我答不上来。茶馆里人来人往，你去问问{name}。

promise_open.en: I said yes. I'll have {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}, and the lanterns are waiting.
promise_open.zh: 应下了。{when}把{amount}根{item}送到桥边，灯等着呢。

promise_open.en: I don't forget what's agreed. It's {amount} poles of {item}, at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说好的事忘不了。{amount}根{item}，{when}送到桥边。

said_already.en: I said so a moment ago.
I've said it. Don't ask again.

testified.en: What I tell you, I saw with my own two eyes.
testified.zh: 我讲的，都是自己亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I can tell you the part I saw. Leave the rest aside for now.
testified.zh: 我只能讲看见的那一段，旁的先别算上。

timeout.en: A lantern is waiting for its finishing touches. I have to get back.
timeout.zh: 灯还等着收尾，我得回去了。

timeout.en: The festival is nearly here and the work won't wait.
timeout.zh: 灯会就在眼前，活儿不等人。

too_late.en: It's pitch dark. Come in the daytime tomorrow.
too_late.zh: 天黑透了，明天白天再来。

too_late.en: I have to watch the lanterns tonight. Let's talk in the morning.
too_late.zh: 夜里要守着灯，明早再说。

took_in.en: I see what happened now you've explained that part.
took_in.zh: 你把这段说明白了，我也就知道怎么回事了。

took_in.en: Thank you for coming to tell me. I'll keep it in mind.
took_in.zh: 多谢你特地来讲，这事我记着。

turned_down.en: Sorry, I can't promise that.
turned_down.zh: 对不住，这个我答应不了。

turned_down.en: That's one I can't nod to.

unknown.en: That one I really don't know.
I haven't been keeping up with that.

will_ask.en: Good, I'll go and find out.
I'll make the trip for you.

will_call.en: Good. I'll take a lantern and go and call everyone.
will_call.zh: 好，我提着灯去叫大家。

will_call.en: I'll go and call them. The lamps will be lit in the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去喊人，祠堂里点上灯等着。

will_do.en: Good, I'll make this one.
Leave it to me. It won't be late.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw, and I won't make up more.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看到这些，多的不瞎说。

witness_in_public.en: I tell what I saw, and I won't paper over what I didn't.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见的我说，没看见的不糊弄。

guess_own.en: There's no way to check this. {hedge} {line}.
{hedge} {line}. I'll leave it there until I have something to go on.

guess_unknown.en: Who said it first, I can't trace. {hedge} {line}.
There's nowhere to check it. {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: As I recall it, {teller} said {line}.
{line}. I got that account from {teller}.

known.en: {line}. No need to look it up. Everyone knows.

own.en: I've checked it end to end, and {line}.

rival.en: We need to allow for what {teller} said as well, that {line}.
rival.zh: 还得把{teller}讲的算上，说是{line}。

rival.en: But I heard from {teller} that {line}. The two accounts don't match.
rival.zh: 可我听{teller}说是{line}。这两句话对不上。

seen.en: This much I can vouch for. I was there and saw that {line}.
seen.zh: 这一笔我敢作证，当时我瞧见{line}。

seen.en: {line}. I saw it on the spot.

unknown.en: All I heard was someone saying that {line}.
I heard it said, though I haven't looked into it, that {line}.

asleep.en: The accountant is asleep and doesn't answer.
The accountant sleeps through your call.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. I'll go and count it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，我去点个数。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is here. I'll enter it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到了，我记上一笔。

batch_promised.en: It's entered. It goes to the bridge tomorrow morning.
batch_promised.zh: 已经记上了，明早送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: The first batch comes tomorrow morning.

busy.en: I'm checking this page. If I stop halfway I'll have to start again, so please give me a moment.
busy.zh: 我正对着这一页账，现在停笔就要从头算过，劳您等一会儿。

busy.en: This page isn't added up yet. I can't stop now.
busy.zh: 这页账还没算完，现在不能停。

cannot.en: That's not part of my job.
I can't do it. Find someone else.
cannot.zh: 这个我办不了，您找别人。

caught.en: I thought I could rely on what you said. Once a lie gets around, who can set it straight?
caught.zh: 我原以为您说的可以当真，可假话传出去，往后谁说得清楚？

caught.en: So it was a lie. I won't trust you again.
caught.zh: 原来您说的是瞎话。往后不信您了。

closed.en: I'm not doing that now. Come at another hour.
closed.zh: 现在不办这个，换个时辰再来。

closed.en: I'm not seeing anyone just now. Come back later.
closed.zh: 这会儿不见客，晚些再来。

deal.en: Fine. That's how I'll enter it.

doubted.en: That doesn't match my records.
doubted.zh: 跟我记的对不上。

doubted.en: That differs from the account I got. Who else have you spoken to?
doubted.zh: 这处和我听来的不一样，您还问过谁？

elder_no.en: On these few words alone, I won't accept it.
Without proof, I can't believe it.

elder_yes.en: I've worked it through. Go ahead that way.
The figures come out right that way. No objection.
elder_yes.zh: 这么算就对上了。我没意见。

empty.en: Words without a record don't count.
Nothing in hand, nothing in the books.

evade.en: What's in the books stays in the books.
That's not mine to tell.

gift_dislike.en: I've no use for {item}. Thank you for the thought.
No need for {item}. Thank you all the same.

gift_like.en: Now, {item} I can use. Thank you.
Good {item}. I'll accept this.

gift_neutral.en: Oh, {item}? Fine, accepted.
All right, the {item} will do. Thank you.

goods_enough.en: The books show enough {item}. No need for more.
goods_enough.zh: 账上{item}已经够数，不用再加。

goods_enough.en: The {item} is at the full count. Any more would be too much.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until the rumour is cleared up in public, the bamboo stays where it is.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 谣言没当众说清，竹料不能动。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear it up in public first, then the rest. That's the order.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先当众说清，再谈别的。先后不能乱。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The story's all over town. Until you clear it up, Manager, I'm holding back the money.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话传遍了，总管还没说清楚。这笔钱我不放。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour stands and you've given no account of it, Manager. I won't do this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 谣言还在，总管也没个说法。这事我不办。

keeper_no.en: I keep the ledger myself. We've only just met, so I'd rather leave it put away for now.
keeper_no.zh: 这账本平常由我收着，咱们才认识，您容我先不拿出来。

keeper_no.en: We don't know each other yet. It stays put today.
keeper_no.zh: 我们还不熟，今天不拿出来。

kept_thanks.en: You said you'd see to it, and now you've done exactly that. I'll remember it.
kept_thanks.zh: 您上回说要办这件事，如今果然办妥了，这一笔我记得。

kept_thanks.en: It's just as agreed. I've made a note.
kept_thanks.zh: 跟说好的一样。我记下了。

knew.en: I had that down already.
I know that one.

needs_nod.en: This needs the elder's nod.
The elder hasn't given the word, so I can't touch this money.
needs_nod.zh: 族长没发话，这笔钱我不能动。

not_said.en: That sentence isn't mine.
That doesn't match what I said.

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, so I've nothing to say.
It's not in the books, so I can't say.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这事账上没有，我说不上。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's been cleared up in public. I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 当众说清了，我不拦了。

objection_withdrawn.en: That settles it. Go ahead.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 这下对清了。您接着办吧。

point_heard.en: I couldn't say for certain, but {name} did bring it up. You might ask there.
point_heard.zh: 我这儿说不准，{name}倒提过这件事，您可以去问问。

point_heard.en: I only know that {name} brought it up. You might ask there for the details.
point_heard.zh: 我只知道{name}说过此事，您可以去问得详细些。

point_hub.en: I can't get to the bottom of it from what I have here. You may want to ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这事凭我手头的东西查不出来，您不妨去问{name}。

point_hub.en: I can't look that up. For what the street says, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这个我查不了。街上的说法，去问{name}。

promise_open.en: It's on the books. I deliver {amount} poles of {item} to the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 账上记着，{when}交{amount}根{item}到桥边。

promise_open.en: It's agreed already, no need to enter it twice. I send {amount} poles of {item} over {when}.
promise_open.zh: 答应过了，不用再记一遍。{when}送{amount}根{item}过去。

said_already.en: I've given you my answer already.
I answered once. I won't say it twice.
said_already.zh: 答过一回了，不说第二遍。

testified.en: Everything I say, I've seen myself.
testified.zh: 我说的，都是亲眼看过的。

testified.en: I don't say what I haven't seen myself.
testified.zh: 没亲眼看过的，我不说。

timeout.en: Time's up, and the accounts aren't checked yet.
timeout.zh: 时辰到了，账还没核完。

timeout.en: Today's accounts aren't closed. I'll be going.
timeout.zh: 今天的账还没结，我先走了。

too_late.en: It's past business hours. Come back in the morning.
too_late.zh: 过了办事的时辰，明早再来。

too_late.en: It's late. Tomorrow.

took_in.en: Right, I'll make a note of it.
took_in.zh: 好，我记一笔。

took_in.en: I followed your account. I'll make a note of that part.
took_in.zh: 我听清了，您说的这一段我会记下来。

turned_down.en: The books can't spare the money. I can't agree to it.
turned_down.zh: 这笔钱账上出不来，我不能答应。

turned_down.en: No. I won't agree to this.

unknown.en: There's no entry for that in the books.
I can't say for sure. I have nothing to go on.
unknown.zh: 这事我说不准。手头没凭据。

will_ask.en: Right, I'll go and ask.
I'll pass it on and write down the reply.
will_ask.zh: 我去转告，回话我也记下。

will_call.en: Fine. I'll go house to house and tell everyone to come to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好。我挨家去说，都到祠堂来。

will_call.en: I'll tell each house. See you at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去跟各家说一声。祠堂见。

will_do.en: Fine, I'll handle it.
I can see to it now. I'll let you know when I've checked the figures.
will_do.zh: 眼下就能办，我核过数再给您回话。

witness_in_public.en: I say only what I saw. What's outside the books is not my business.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只说看见的，账外的事我不管。

witness_in_public.en: One thing seen, one thing said.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见一件，就说一件。

lines.en: Remember what you owe.
lines.zh: 记着你欠的。

lines.en: See you at the lanterns. Don't be late.
lines.zh: 灯会上见，别迟到。

lines.en: The two families sat down together. Leave it there.
lines.zh: 两家吃过饭了。别再提了。

lines.en: Move along. You're in the way.
lines.zh: 走吧，别挡着路。

lines.en: Done talking?
lines.zh: 话说完了？

text.en: Zhou Dalang owned up in front of everyone to kicking the railing down when drunk, and paid the cost of the new one.
text.zh: 周家大郎当着众人认下了酒后踢断栏杆的事，赔了新栏杆的工钱。

text.en: Zhou Dalang stood by the bridge with a lantern. This time nobody made a point of the smell of wine.
text.zh: 周家大郎提着灯站在桥边。这一回，没有人拿酒气说事。

text.en: Zhou Dalang finished hauling the last bundle of timber at the bridge and turned into the tavern.
text.zh: 周家大郎在桥边搬完最后一捆木料，转身进了酒肆。

text.en: Zhou Dalang shouldered timber along the lane and never broke stride.
text.zh: 周家大郎扛着木料走了夹道，一路没停脚。

text.en: Zhou Dalang squatted at the door of the tavern, watched the lights at the bridge, and said nothing.
text.zh: 周家大郎蹲在酒肆门口，望着桥那边的灯。一句话没说。

guess_unknown.en: Some loudmouth said it, but {hedge} {line}.
It's going round the whole street, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: {line}. I heard it from {teller}. You can ask if you don't believe me.
heard.zh: {line}，是{teller}跟我说的，你要不信就去问。

heard.en: You're asking me? I got it from {teller}, who said {line}.
heard.zh: 你问我？我也是听{teller}说的，说{line}。

rival.en: But {teller} told it differently, saying {line}.
rival.zh: 可{teller}讲的跟这不一样。{line}。

rival.en: But {teller} went and said {line}.
rival.zh: 可{teller}非说{line}。

seen.en: I watched it happen myself, and I can tell you that {line}.
seen.zh: 这事我从头就看在眼里，{line}。

seen.en: {line}, and yes, that's the part I actually saw.

unknown.en: People are blabbing that {line}.
It's all over the street, that {line}. Who started it, I don't care.
unknown.zh: 满街乱传，{line}。谁起的头，我才不管。

lines.en: Are you the new Manager? I'm Zhou Dalang. Say what you came for. I've work to get back to.
lines.zh: 你就是新来的总管？我叫周家大郎，有事你便说，我还得回去干活。

lines.en: Your word counts for nothing. I remember.
lines.zh: 你说话不算数，我记着。

lines.en: Not a drop for me tonight. The parade's on.
lines.zh: 今晚游灯，我滴酒不沾。

lines.en: They've sorted out what happened to the bridge. What are you still looking at me for?
lines.zh: 桥的事都说清了。还盯着我干什么？

lines.en: Both houses at one table. Hm. Fine.
lines.zh: 两家坐一桌了。哼，也行。

lines.en: The bridge is finally mended, and I didn't shirk my share of carrying the timber.
lines.zh: 桥总算修好了，送到桥边的木头可没少我扛的那一份。

lines.en: You did what you said. Fine, one point to you.
lines.zh: 你应的办了。行，记你一回。

lines.en: They set the story about the Li boy straight in front of everyone. Could've done that sooner.
lines.zh: 李家老二那事当众说清了。早说清不就完了。

lines.en: You again.
lines.zh: 又是你。

lines.en: Quick.
lines.zh: 快说。

lines.en: Say what you want. Don't dawdle.
lines.zh: 有事说事，别磨叽。

lines.en: Ask if you're going to. I've work on.
lines.zh: 要问就问，我手上有活。

bamboo_arrived.en: Bamboo's here. Get on with it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到了，看着办吧。

bamboo_arrived.en: The stock's come. Don't just stand there.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料送来了，别愣着。

batch_promised.en: Fine. It'll be there in the morning. Don't push me.
First thing tomorrow. I do what I say.

busy.en: No time. Don't pester me.
busy.zh: 没空，别来烦我。

busy.en: I can't talk now. It can wait.
busy.zh: 我这会儿顾不上你。有话等会儿说。

cannot.en: Can't do it. Ask somebody else.
Can't help. That's all.

caught.en: I thought I could take your word for it, and you've been feeding me lies!
caught.zh: 我还当你说的话有准儿，原来也敢拿瞎话糊弄我！

caught.en: What else have you got to say to me? Go away.
caught.zh: 还跟我说什么？走开。

closed.en: Not now. Come later.
closed.zh: 现在不行，晚点来。

closed.en: Don't come now. Try another hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿别来，换个时辰。

deal.en: Right. Don't go back on it.

doubted.en: That part doesn't match what I heard. Who told you?
doubted.zh: 你说的这段跟我听的对不上，你是从谁那儿听来的？

doubted.en: Something's off. It doesn't match what I heard.
doubted.zh: 不对劲，跟我听的对不上。

elder_no.en: Is that all? Not enough.
Still not good enough. I'm not convinced.

elder_yes.en: Fine. I accept it.
You've got a point. So be it.
elder_yes.zh: 你说的有点道理，就这样。

empty.en: Empty talk. I don't buy it.
Show me something real, then talk.

evade.en: You ask too many questions.
None of your business!

gift_dislike.en: Some {item}? I don't drink that.
What would I want with {item}? I'm no old man.
gift_dislike.zh: 拿{item}来干什么？我又不是老头子。

gift_like.en: Some {item}? You know what's good.
Some {item}. Now that's more like it.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? What's that for? Put that down somewhere.
Some {item}, I suppose. Thanks.

goods_enough.en: Enough. Can't you see the {item} at the bridge?
goods_enough.zh: 够了，桥边的{item}你没看见吗？

goods_enough.en: The {item} is enough, so stop bothering me.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear that talk up in public first. You'll get nothing from me till then.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清，别想从我这儿拿东西。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that's cleared up, forget it.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那话不说清楚，这事免谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town's talking and you keep your mouth shut. Nothing to lend. Go.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 全镇都在传，你一声不吭。没得借，走人。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: After all that's been said, you're still keeping quiet? Don't count on me agreeing.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 传成这样了你还不说话？别指望我点头。

hard_other.en: Not happening. Asking again changes nothing.

keeper_no.en: We hardly know each other. Why ask me to show you that straight off?
keeper_no.zh: 你我又不熟，怎么一上来就找我要东西看？

keeper_no.en: You've only just come around. I can't show you that yet.
keeper_no.zh: 你这才刚来，我还不能给你看。

kept_thanks.en: Truth be told, I didn't expect you to keep your word. Since you did, I owe you one.
kept_thanks.zh: 说实话，我原没打算信你，既然事情办成了，我也不赖你这份情。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you said. Fine, I owe you one.
kept_thanks.zh: 说到做到。行，欠你一回。

knew.en: Knew it already. No need for you to tell me.
I'm aware of that.

needs_nod.en: Have to ask my father first.
My father hasn't agreed. My word isn't enough.
needs_nod.zh: 我爹没点头，我说了不算。

not_said.en: I never said that. Don't pin it on me.
not_said.zh: 我没说过，别往我身上栽。

not_said.en: Who says I said it?

nothing_to_say.en: Nothing to say.
Got nothing to say.

objection_withdrawn.en: It's been said. Fine, I won't stop you.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚了。行，我不拦。

objection_withdrawn.en: Enough. I won't block your way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 得了，不挡你的道。

point_heard.en: I only heard {name} say a word or two. How should I know the rest? Go and ask.
point_heard.zh: 我就听{name}说过这么一嘴，旁的我哪晓得？你要问就去问。

point_heard.en: I only caught a bit. If you've got questions, take them to {name}.
point_heard.zh: 我就听过一耳朵，你有话直接问{name}去。

point_hub.en: I've no time to ask around about that. Try {name} if you want the whole story.
point_hub.zh: 我哪有空打听这些，你去问{name}，兴许还能听全了。

point_hub.en: I've no time for idle talk. If you want news, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我没工夫管闲事，要打听就去问{name}。

promise_open.en: I said yes, and that's that. It's {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 应了就是应了，{when}送{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: I said I'd bring it, so I'll drop {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说了送就送，{when}把{amount}根{item}扔到桥边。

said_already.en: I said it already. Don't you understand?
I just said it. Don't make me say it twice.
said_already.zh: 刚说完，别让我说第二遍。

testified.en: I say what I saw. Nothing else.
testified.zh: 我看到什么就说什么，别的没有。

testified.en: I could see clearly what happened. I've told you all I can.
testified.zh: 当时的情形我瞧得清楚，能说的就这些。

timeout.en: That's enough. I haven't time to waste on you.
timeout.zh: 行了，我没工夫陪你耗。

timeout.en: I'm done talking. I've got things to do.
timeout.zh: 不聊了，我还有事。

too_late.en: Too late. Come tomorrow.
It's dark. Let it wait till tomorrow.

took_in.en: Hm. Got it.
took_in.zh: 哦，知道了。

took_in.en: I get it now you've put it that way. I'll remember it.
took_in.zh: 你这么一说我就明白了，这话我记着。

turned_down.en: No. When I say no, I mean no.
turned_down.zh: 不答应，我说不行就不行。

turned_down.en: No chance.

unknown.en: How should I know?
No idea. Don't ask me.

will_ask.en: Fine, I'll tell them.
Got it, I'll ask.

will_call.en: Fine, I'll round them up. Everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我去叫人。都去祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll call them. Wait at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去喊人，祠堂等着。

will_do.en: Fine, I'll do it.
Got it. I'll handle it.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. Don't ask for more.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这些，别问多的。

witness_in_public.en: What I saw is what I saw. Quit nagging.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见多少是多少，少啰嗦。

guess_heard.en: From the sound of what {teller} said, {hedge} {line}.

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. You might want to ask someone else, too.

guess_unknown.en: I don't know who raised it, but {hedge} {line}.
It only reached me by ear, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I first heard it from {teller}, who said {line}.
I once heard {teller} talk about this and say {line}.

rival.en: I heard another account from {teller}, to the effect that {line}.
rival.zh: 我还从{teller}那儿听过不同的说法，说是{line}。

rival.en: There's one more thing. I heard {teller} say {line}.
rival.zh: 还有一件。我听{teller}说{line}。

seen.en: I was nearby at the time and can tell you I saw that {line}.
seen.zh: 我那会儿正在旁边，{line}，确实是我自己看见的。

seen.en: I remember seeing it myself: {line}.

unknown.en: It's only something I heard, that {line}.
There's talk around town that {line}. Who began it, I couldn't say.
unknown.zh: 镇上有人在传，{line}。是谁先说的，我不清楚。

asleep.en: You call twice. All you hear is breathing.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo has reached the bridge. That's wonderful.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，太好了。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is here, thanks to everyone who helped.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料到了，多亏大家帮忙。

batch_promised.en: Certainly. It will be at the bridge tomorrow morning, rest assured.
batch_promised.zh: 好，明早一定送到桥边。你放心。

batch_promised.en: I'll bring it myself in the morning, without delay.
batch_promised.zh: 明早我亲自送去，误不了。

busy.en: Forgive me, I've something I can't leave just now. Could we talk when I've finished?
busy.zh: 对不住，我这会儿实在走不开，等手上的事办完了再跟您细说，好吗？

busy.en: Please wait a moment, Manager. I have something in hand.
busy.zh: 麻烦总管等一等，我手上还有事。

cannot.en: I'm sorry, I can't help with that.
cannot.zh: 对不住，这个忙我帮不上。

cannot.en: That's really beyond me.

caught.en: I took what you told me at face value. I never thought you'd lie to me.
caught.zh: 您方才那番话，我原是当真的，没想到您会骗我。

caught.en: You lied to me. I never expected it.
caught.zh: 你骗了我，我真没想到。

closed.en: This isn't a good moment. Please come at another hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿不太方便，换个时辰再来吧。

closed.en: Sorry, not now. Please come again later.
closed.zh: 对不住，现在不行。晚点再来吧。

deal.en: All right. That's settled between us.

doubted.en: Forgive me, but one part differs from what I heard. Could you tell me a little more?
doubted.zh: 对不住，有一段跟我听的不一样，您可愿再说说？

doubted.en: It differs a little from what I heard.
doubted.zh: 跟我听到的有点不一样。

elder_no.en: On this alone, I'm afraid it isn't enough.
I still need to think it over.

elder_yes.en: I understand. Let it be as you say.
elder_yes.zh: 我明白了，就照你说的办。

elder_yes.en: You make sense. I'm persuaded.

empty.en: Only empty words. I can't bring myself to believe them.
empty.zh: 只有一句空话，我不敢信。

empty.en: Without anything to back it, I can't just believe it.

evade.en: That... it isn't for me to speak for the family.
evade.zh: 这个……我不好替家里说话。

evade.en: Please don't ask me that, all right?

gift_dislike.en: Sorry, I don't touch {item}. But thank you for the thought.
gift_dislike.zh: 对不住，{item}我不沾。您的心意我领了。

gift_dislike.en: No {item} for me, sorry. My brother's the one who drinks.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}就不用了，对不住。我哥倒是爱喝。

gift_like.en: Some {item}... thank you so much. I was hoping for some.
I'm very fond of {item}. You shouldn't have gone to the trouble.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. That's kind of you to remember me.
I'll take the {item} home for my mother to try.
gift_neutral.zh: {item}我收下了，带回去给我娘尝尝。

goods_enough.en: Forgive me, but the {item} at the bridge is enough already.
goods_enough.zh: 不好意思，桥边的{item}已经够了。

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} already, and more would be wasted, I'm afraid.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that talk is cleared up before everyone, I can't help in this. I'm so sorry.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话一天没当众说清，这事我就帮不了。实在对不住。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Could it be cleared up in public first? Then we can talk.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 能不能先当众把话说清楚？然后再谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: I'm so sorry. The talk is spreading badly, and you've said nothing, Manager. I can't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 实在对不住。闲话传得厉害，总管又一直没出声。这事我不好答应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Forgive me. The street talk won't stop, and you haven't said a word, Manager. I can't say yes.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 对不住。街上闲话不断，总管也没说句话。我不好点头。

hard_other.en: I'm afraid that is out of the question.
There's no room to discuss it, I'm sorry.
hard_other.zh: 这件事没法商量，对不住。

keeper_no.en: It wouldn't be right to bring that out the first time we meet.
keeper_no.zh: 您问的这个，我不好一见面就拿出来。

keeper_no.en: I can't show this to someone I don't know.
keeper_no.zh: 这个我不好给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: With all you've got to do, you still remembered your promise to me. Thank you.
kept_thanks.zh: 您事情这样多，还记得答应我的这件，我得谢谢您。

kept_thanks.en: You did as you said. Thank you so much.
kept_thanks.zh: 你说到做到，真谢谢你。

knew.en: I'd heard something of it already.
Thank you, though I knew of it before.
knew.zh: 谢谢，不过我先前就知道了。

needs_nod.en: I'd need to ask my father first.
I'd better speak to my father before I give you an answer.
needs_nod.zh: 我得先跟父亲商量过，才好给您回话。

not_said.en: I didn't say anything of the sort.
There must be a misunderstanding. I didn't say it.
not_said.zh: 怕是误会了，这话我没说过。

not_so.zh: 不好意思，事情不是那样。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see anything that night, so I can't tell you much.
nothing_to_say.zh: 那晚的事我没看见，说不上什么。

nothing_to_say.en: Sorry, I really have nothing to say.
nothing_to_say.zh: 对不住，我实在没什么可说的。

objection_withdrawn.en: I'm glad the misunderstanding is cleared. I won't stand in the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 误会解开了就好，我不再拦着。

objection_withdrawn.en: Good that it's clear. I'm sorry for standing in the way earlier.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 说清楚就好，刚才多有得罪。

point_heard.en: I happened to hear {name} mention it. I'm not sure of the details myself, but you might find out more there.
point_heard.zh: 我偶然听{name}提起过，自己也弄不明白，您去问问兴许能知道得详细些。

point_heard.en: Why not ask {name}? That's where I heard about it.
point_heard.zh: 要不你找{name}问问？这事我也是听来的。

point_hub.en: I don't know much about that. If you'd like to know more, you could ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这件事我不大清楚，您要是还想问，可以找{name}打听一下。

point_hub.en: I'm so sorry, I can't answer. News travels fast at the teahouse, so perhaps ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 实在对不住，我答不上来。茶馆里消息灵通，不如去问{name}。

promise_open.en: I've already agreed. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} to the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这事我已经应下了。{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边。

promise_open.en: Don't worry, I remember. It will be {amount} poles of {item}, delivered {when}.
promise_open.zh: 你放心，我记着的。{amount}根{item}，{when}送到。

said_already.en: I said as much just now.
I said as much a moment ago.

testified.en: What I've told you, I saw with my own eyes.
testified.zh: 我说的，都是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I can vouch for the part I saw myself. I can't speak to the rest.
testified.zh: 我只能作证哪一段亲眼见过，其余的还不敢说。

timeout.en: Forgive me, I have to get on.
timeout.zh: 不好意思，我得先去忙了。

timeout.en: There's something waiting at home. Another day.
timeout.zh: 家里还有事等着我，改日再聊。

too_late.en: It's late now. Let's talk in the morning.
It's too late. Please come tomorrow.
too_late.zh: 时候太晚了，请明天再来。

took_in.en: Thank you for explaining. I understand what happened now.
took_in.zh: 多亏您肯说明白，我这回知道怎么回事了。

took_in.en: I heard what you said, and I'll keep it in mind.
took_in.zh: 您刚才说的我都听见了，我会放在心上。

turned_down.en: I'm so sorry, but I can't agree to this.
turned_down.zh: 实在对不住，这件事我不能答应。

turned_down.en: Forgive me, I really can't say yes to it.
turned_down.zh: 对不住，这个我真应不了。

unknown.en: I'm afraid I really don't know about that.
I haven't heard of it, I'm afraid.

will_ask.en: Of course, I'll go and put in a good word.
I'll pass it on for you.

will_call.en: Of course, I'll go and ask everyone to the hall.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去请各家到祠堂来。

will_call.en: I'll let everyone know. See you at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去告诉大家，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Certainly, I'll see to it.
No trouble at all, rest assured.

witness_in_public.en: I can only say what I saw. About the rest I really don't know.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只能说我看到的，别的实在不清楚。

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw, and I won't say more.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只看见这些，不敢多说。

lines.en: Don't forget what you promised.
lines.zh: 您别忘了答应过的话。

lines.en: I'll go and mind the shop. Mind your step.
lines.zh: 我看铺子去了，您慢走。

lines.en: You said it in public, so I'm not afraid any more.
lines.zh: 您当众说了，我就不怕了。

lines.en: That was the only thing I said. Please remember it.
lines.zh: 我只说了那一句，您记着。

lines.en: Take care on your way. I'd better get back to work.
lines.zh: 您慢走，小的先回去干活了。

lines.en: Mind your step. I have work to do.
lines.zh: 您慢走，我还有活。

text.en: The Manager's promise went unkept. After that, Zhou's clerk sent anyone who came asking to the shopkeeper.
text.zh: 总管应的话没兑现。后来再来打听，周家伙计只让人去问掌柜的。

text.en: Zhou's Clerk went on hauling timber at the shop. Nobody stopped the clerk any more to ask what had been seen that night.
text.zh: 周家伙计照旧在铺子里搬木料。再没有人拦住伙计，追问那晚看见了什么。

text.en: Zhou's Clerk told it plainly at last. That night the clerk had seen only Li Er at the bridge, looking for a lantern.
text.zh: 周家伙计总算讲清了，那晚只看见李二在桥边找灯笼。

text.en: Zhou's clerk still kept to the back of the shop and looked down at the floor whenever anyone brought up the bridge.
text.zh: 周家伙计仍躲在铺子后头，听见有人提到桥，就低下头去。

guess_heard.en: {teller} said a word about it, and {hedge} {line}.

guess_own.en: I can't be sure of it, but {hedge} {line}.

guess_unknown.en: I couldn't say who said it, but {hedge} {line}.
I only heard it in passing, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: That part came from {teller}, who said that {line}.
As for that part, I heard from {teller} that {line}.
heard.zh: 至于这句，小的是听{teller}说的，说是{line}。

known.en: {line}. The whole town knows that much.

own.en: As I see it, if I may, {line}.
Here's how it looks to me: {line}.

rival.en: I heard a different account from {teller}, who said {line}.
rival.zh: 小的还听过{teller}另一番话，说{line}。

rival.en: I heard another account from {teller}, who said that {line}.
rival.zh: 小的还听过另一句，是{teller}说的，说是{line}。

seen.en: I was right nearby and saw for myself that {line}.
seen.zh: 小的当时在跟前，亲眼瞧见{line}。

seen.en: What I saw with my own eyes was that {line}.
seen.zh: 小的亲眼看的是这件事，{line}。

unknown.en: There's talk going round, if you please, that {line}.
I only heard it myself, that {line}. Who said it, I couldn't tell you.
unknown.zh: 我也是听来的，说是{line}。是谁说的，记不得了。

lines.en: Are you the new Manager, may I ask? I work for the Zhou shop. Did you want the shopkeeper, or is there something you'd like to ask me?
lines.zh: 敢问您是新来的总管吗？小的在周家铺子帮忙，您要见掌柜的，还是有事问我？

lines.en: I haven't forgotten your promise, but I didn't dare come and ask you about it again.
lines.zh: 上回您答应的事，小的一直记着，就是没敢再来问。

lines.en: Go and see the lanterns. The shopkeeper asked me to stay and mind the shop tonight.
lines.zh: 您去看灯吧，掌柜的叫小的今晚留下来看铺子。

lines.en: Now that everyone's heard what happened at the bridge, you know I told it as I saw it.
lines.zh: 如今桥的事当众说清了，您也知道小的当初是照实讲的。

lines.en: The two houses have made peace, and a weight is off my shoulders.
lines.zh: 两家和好了，我心里也轻松了。

lines.en: You kept your word. I never expected it.
lines.zh: 您说到做到，我真没想到。

lines.en: All I said was that I saw Li Er at the bridge. Now everyone's heard what I actually said.
lines.zh: 小的当初只说看见李家老二在桥边，如今大伙儿也听清那句了。

lines.en: You're back? I'm here.
lines.zh: 您又来了？小的在。

lines.en: Anything more you need?
lines.zh: 还有什么吩咐？

lines.en: Tell me what you need. If there's a decision to make, it still goes through the shopkeeper.
lines.zh: 您跟小的说吧，要拿主意，还得找掌柜的。

lines.en: I'm slow with words. Please ask slowly.
lines.zh: 小的嘴笨，您慢慢问。

asleep.en: Your call doesn't wake the clerk.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is at the bridge. I've had a look.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，我去看过了。

bamboo_arrived.en: I thought you'd want to know. The bamboo has reached the bridge.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 跟您说一声，竹料送到桥边了。

batch_promised.en: Yes, I'll have it at the bridge tomorrow morning.
Don't worry. It will be there in the morning without fail.

busy.en: The shopkeeper gave me work and is waiting to hear from me. May I finish that first? Could you come back a little later?
busy.zh: 掌柜的交代了事，还等着我回话呢。我先去把活做完，您晚些再来行吗？

busy.en: The master's errand isn't done yet. I daren't dawdle.
busy.zh: 掌柜的吩咐的活还没干完，不敢耽搁。

cannot.en: This favour is really beyond me.
cannot.zh: 这个忙，小的实在帮不上。

cannot.en: I haven't the means for it.

caught.en: I didn't dare question what you told me. You had me almost taking it for the truth.
caught.zh: 小的哪敢疑心您说的话，没承想叫您这么一哄，差点还当了真。

caught.en: You lied to me. I was ready to believe the whole thing.
caught.zh: 您骗了我，我差点就信到底了。

closed.en: It's not a good moment. If you could come at another hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿不方便，您换个时辰来。

closed.en: This hour won't do. Please come back later.
closed.zh: 这个时辰不行，您晚些再来。

deal.en: Very well, very well. It's agreed.

doubted.en: That's new to me. What I was told went differently.
doubted.zh: 您这话小的还没听过，先前听来的可不是这一句。

doubted.en: That's not quite what I was told.
doubted.zh: 这和我听的不太一样。

elder_no.en: On this alone, I can't believe it yet.
You'll have to say a little more, please.

elder_yes.en: I understand. Let it be done so.
You are right. I am convinced.

empty.en: Words alone are no use. I daren't believe them.
Without proof, I daren't take it seriously.

evade.en: That's not for me to decide. You must ask the master.
evade.zh: 这个小的做不了主，您得问掌柜的。

evade.en: Please don't put me on the spot.

gift_dislike.en: I've no use for {item}... but I wouldn't dare refuse.
Ah, {item}... the shop has no use for that. Thank you for thinking of me.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}啊……铺子里用不着这个。谢谢您想着。

gift_like.en: For me? Some {item}... you shouldn't have. Thank you.
gift_like.zh: 给小的？{item}……这怎么好意思。多谢您。

gift_like.en: Some {item}, just what I wanted. Thank you.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}? Thank you kindly.
Some {item}, then. If the master asks, I'll say this came from you.
gift_neutral.zh: {item}也好。掌柜的问起，我就说是您给的。

goods_enough.en: To answer you, the {item} at the bridge is enough.
I checked. The {item} is all there, and I daren't send more.
goods_enough.zh: 我看过了。{item}够数，不敢再多送。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: That talk hasn't been cleared up in public. It isn't mine to decide.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些话没当众说清，小的不敢做主。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: The master said so. Until it's cleared up, nothing else can be talked about.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 掌柜的说了。话不说清楚，什么都免谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is spreading that talk, and you say nothing, Manager. I daren't agree.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 镇上都在传那些闲话，总管又一声不吭。我不敢答应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The talk has got this bad and you haven't spoken, Manager. It's not for me to decide.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话闹成这样，总管也不发话。我哪敢做主。

hard_other.en: That is quite out of the question.

keeper_no.en: We hardly know each other. It's not for me to say.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们还不熟，这个我不敢做主。

keeper_no.en: The master said strangers aren't to look.
keeper_no.zh: 掌柜的吩咐过，生人不能看。

kept_thanks.en: I didn't dare ask you about it again. I'm grateful you remembered and saw it through.
kept_thanks.zh: 我原不敢再来问您，没想到总管一直记着，真把事办到了。

kept_thanks.en: You keep your word, Manager. I'll remember.
kept_thanks.zh: 总管说话算数，我记着。

knew.en: I'd heard about that already.
That matter you mention, I know of it.

needs_nod.en: I must ask the master first.
The master hasn't agreed. I daren't say yes.
needs_nod.zh: 掌柜的没点头，我不敢应。

not_said.en: If you mean that story, please don't put it down to me.
not_said.zh: 您要问那句话，可别算在小的头上。

not_said.en: Is that what you heard? That's not what I said.
not_said.zh: 您听来的是那句？小的没那么说。

not_so.en: No, that's not it. You've misunderstood.
It wasn't like that. Let me tell you.
not_so.zh: 事情不是这样的，您听我说。

nothing_to_say.en: I've nothing to say.
It isn't for me to say more.

objection_withdrawn.en: Now that everyone understands what was said, I won't stand in your way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 大伙儿既然把话听明白了，小的就不拦您了。

objection_withdrawn.en: The master has agreed. I'll get out of the way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 掌柜的点了头，我这就让开。

point_heard.en: I just heard {name} mention it once. You might get a clearer account if you ask in person.
point_heard.zh: 小的只听见{name}提过一回，具体是怎么回事，您亲自问问兴许就清楚了。

point_heard.en: You might ask {name}. I only heard the gist.
point_heard.zh: 您找{name}问问看。我只听了个大概。

point_hub.en: I know too little to risk telling you wrong. Try {name}. More of the town's news gets there.
point_hub.zh: 小的知道得少，怕跟您说岔了。您去找{name}问问，那儿听来的消息多。

point_hub.en: I can't answer, so please don't blame me. For the town's business, {name} is the one to ask.
point_hub.zh: 我答不上来，您别怪。镇上的事，找{name}准没错。

promise_open.en: I've already said yes. I'll bring {amount} poles of {item} to the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 已经答应您了，{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边。

promise_open.en: To answer you, it's promised already, and {amount} poles of {item} come {when}.
promise_open.zh: 回您的话，答应过了。{when}送{amount}根{item}。

said_already.en: I told you that a moment ago.
Already told you, truly.

testified.en: What I say, I saw with my own eyes.
testified.zh: 我说的都是亲眼瞧见的。

testified.en: I daren't speak of things I didn't see.
testified.zh: 没看见的事，我不敢乱讲。

timeout.en: I must get back to work, or the master will scold me.
timeout.zh: 得回去干活了，不然掌柜的要骂。

timeout.en: The shop is waiting for me. I'll be going.
timeout.zh: 铺子里还等着人，我先走了。

too_late.en: It's late. Please come in the morning.
The shop is closing. Please come tomorrow.
too_late.zh: 铺子该关门了，您明天再来。

took_in.en: Yes, yes, I'll remember it.
took_in.zh: 是是，记下了。

took_in.en: So that's it. Thank you for telling me.
took_in.zh: 原来是这样，多谢您告诉我。

turned_down.en: The master hasn't given the word, so I daren't agree.
turned_down.zh: 掌柜的没发话，小的不敢答应。

turned_down.en: It isn't mine to decide. Please forgive me.
turned_down.zh: 这事我做不了主，您多担待。

unknown.en: I wouldn't know about that.
I've not heard of it, and I daren't guess.

will_ask.en: Yes, I'll go and ask on your behalf.
I'll pass the word along.

will_call.en: Yes, I'll go and invite everyone to the hall right away.
will_call.zh: 是，这就去请大家到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll go house to house and tell them.
will_call.zh: 我去挨家挨户通知。

will_do.en: Yes, I'll see to it at once.
Don't worry, leave it to me.

witness_in_public.en: I can tell you what I saw for myself. For the rest, you'll have to ask whoever told it.
witness_in_public.zh: 小的说的是亲眼瞧见的，听别人讲的那些，您还得找说话的人问。

witness_in_public.en: I can vouch for what I saw myself. I can't speak to what others have said.
witness_in_public.zh: 您要问亲眼见的，小的能作证。旁人讲的那些，小的可不敢认。

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. If the neighbors ask, keep it to yourself for now.
guess_own.zh: {hedge}{line}。街坊问起来，你也先别往外说。

guess_unknown.en: I couldn't say who started it, but {hedge} {line}.
Who I heard it from, don't ask me, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I got it straight from {teller}, who said {line}.
I remember this bit. I heard from {teller} that {line}.
heard.zh: 这句我记得，是{teller}说的，说是{line}。

known.en: {line}. There's nobody who doesn't know that.
{line}. I'm telling you, there's nobody in this town who doesn't know.
known.zh: {line}。我跟你讲，这镇上没人不知道。

rival.en: You might also want to hear what {teller} told me, that {line}.
rival.zh: 您也听听我从{teller}那儿听来的，说是{line}。

rival.en: But I'm sure I heard {teller} say {line}.
rival.zh: 可我明明听{teller}说过，{line}。

seen.en: I was standing right there and saw for myself that {line}.
seen.zh: 我就站在旁边呢，亲眼瞧见{line}。

seen.en: With my own two eyes I saw that {line}.

unknown.en: All the neighbours are saying {line}.
I overheard some gossip, that {line}. Who started it, I wouldn't know.
unknown.zh: 我听人嚼舌头，{line}。谁先说的，我可不知道。

asleep.en: Madam Zhou has gone to sleep.
Madam Zhou sleeps right through it.

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo's at the bridge. I just saw it.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹子到桥边啦，我刚瞧见的。

bamboo_arrived.en: See that? The bamboo's all come.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 瞧见没？竹料都送来了。

batch_promised.en: Good. It'll be at the bridge tomorrow morning.
Let me tell you, it goes out the moment it gets light.
batch_promised.zh: 我跟你讲，天一亮就送去。

busy.en: I've more to do than I can get through just now. Come back a little later and we can talk properly.
busy.zh: 手里这么多事一时做不完，你晚些来找我，到时候咱们好好说。

busy.en: I'm talking with someone. Wait a moment.
busy.zh: 我正跟人说话呢，你等等。

cannot.en: That's one I can't help with.
That I can't do.

caught.en: Did you think I was that easy to fool? I believed you just now. Don't count on it next time.
caught.zh: 你当我真好哄呢？刚才我信了你的话，下回你可别指望还有这么容易。

caught.en: Why'd you tell me that? I took it for the truth.
caught.zh: 你哄我干什么？我还当真了。

closed.en: Not a good time now. Come at some other hour.
closed.zh: 这会儿不方便，换个时辰来。

closed.en: Not right now. Come back in a while.
closed.zh: 现在可不行，等会儿再来。

doubted.en: That differs from what I heard. Where did you ask about it?
doubted.zh: 我听来的有些出入，您是在哪儿打听的？

doubted.en: There's another account of it. Let me hear a little more.
doubted.zh: 这事还有别的说法，容我再听听。

elder_no.en: Just on those few words? That's not enough.
elder_no.zh: 就凭这几句话？还不够呢。

elder_no.en: That won't do on its own. I need to think more.
elder_no.zh: 光这样可不行，我还得再想想。

elder_yes.en: I understand. Let's settle it so.
elder_yes.zh: 我听明白了，就这么定吧。

elder_yes.en: Now I see what you mean. All right.
elder_yes.zh: 这么一讲我就明白了。成。

empty.en: Pretty words. I don't believe them for a moment.
empty.zh: 嘴上说得好听，我才不信呢。

empty.en: Empty talk. Anyone can say that.

evade.en: I daren't spread that. They'd only say it came from me.
evade.zh: 这事我可不敢乱讲，回头又说是我传的。

evade.en: Oh, that's hard to say. Greens went up two coppers again the other day...
evade.zh: 这个呀，不好说。前两天青菜又涨了两文……

gift_dislike.en: I don't touch {item}. One drinker in the house is trouble enough.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}我不碰。家里有一个爱喝的就够我烦了。

gift_dislike.en: Never mind the {item}. Keep it.

gift_like.en: Some {item}! How did you know I love these?
I'll take the {item}. I'm telling you, you know how to get on with people.
gift_like.zh: {item}我收下了。我跟你讲，你这人会来事。

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}. Leave it, Erlang can use it.
Some {item}, that's nice. Thanks.

goods_enough.en: Let me tell you, there's enough {item} at the bridge already.
goods_enough.zh: 我跟你讲，桥边的{item}早就够啦。

goods_enough.en: Enough {item} already. What more would you send.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that talk is cleared up in public, nobody gets a thing from us.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清，谁也别想从我家要东西。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear it up in public first. Nothing else is up for discussion.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先把话当众说明白，别的免谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: Let me tell you, the whole town is talking. And you say not a word, so I won't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 我跟你讲，满镇都在传。你倒一声不吭，这事我不应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The talk is flying everywhere and you say nothing. How am I to nod?
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话传得满天飞，你也不吭声。叫我怎么点头？

keeper_no.en: We've only just met. Let's leave that until we know one another a little better.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们才刚认得，这个还是等熟了再说吧。

keeper_no.en: That isn't for strangers to look at.
keeper_no.zh: 这个可不好给生人看。

kept_thanks.en: You've plenty to see to, Manager, and you still kept your promise to me. I won't forget it.
kept_thanks.zh: 总管手里的事那么多，还想着把答应我的给办了，这份情我自然记着。

kept_thanks.en: You did it. Ask if you ever need anything.
kept_thanks.zh: 你办到了呀，往后有事尽管开口。

knew.en: You needn't tell me. The whole street is talking about it.
knew.zh: 你不说我也知道，街坊都传遍了。

knew.en: Let me tell you, someone told me that already.
knew.zh: 我跟你讲，这事早有人跟我说过了。

needs_nod.en: I'll have to ask my husband first.
needs_nod.zh: 这得先问问我家掌柜的。

needs_nod.en: If my husband doesn't nod, I wouldn't dare say yes.
needs_nod.zh: 掌柜的不点头，我可不敢应。

not_said.en: I never said that, so don't go spreading it.
Those weren't my words, mind.

not_so.en: It wasn't like that at all.
You must have heard wrong. It was nothing like that.
not_so.zh: 你听错了吧，根本不是那样。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see it, so I daren't say.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这事我没看见，可不敢瞎说。

nothing_to_say.en: There's really nothing to tell.

objection_withdrawn.en: Now it's out in the open, I won't stand in your way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 话说开了，我也不拦着了。

objection_withdrawn.en: Let me tell you, this time I'm satisfied. Go ahead.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 我跟你讲，这回我服气了。你去吧。

point_heard.en: I only caught the start of it. If you want to know, you might as well go straight to {name}.
point_heard.zh: 我只听了个开头，你既然想知道，索性找{name}问个明白。

point_heard.en: I only heard a few words from {name}. You'll have to ask there to get to the bottom of it.
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}说了几句，您得问那边才知道究竟。

point_hub.en: I haven't heard the whole thing. If you want it straight, you'll do better asking {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这话我可没听全，你要问清楚，去找{name}总比问我强。

point_hub.en: I wouldn't know. If it's gossip you're after, ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我可不晓得。要打听闲话，就去问{name}。

promise_open.en: What I promise is as good as done. It's {amount} poles of {item} {when}.
promise_open.zh: 我答应过的事错不了，{when}送{amount}根{item}。

promise_open.en: It's all agreed. Those {amount} poles of {item} reach the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 说好的呀。{amount}根{item}，{when}到桥边。

said_already.en: I told you already.
I've only just said it, and you ask again.

testified.en: Everything I tell you, I saw with my own eyes.
testified.zh: 我讲的可都是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: I was standing right there at the time.
testified.zh: 我当时就站在那儿呢。

timeout.en: I've a pot on the stove. I have to get back.
timeout.zh: 灶上还炖着东西呢，我得回去了。

timeout.en: A houseful of chores is waiting. I can't chat longer.
timeout.zh: 家里一摊子事，不跟你多聊了。

too_late.en: It's so late. Come again in the morning.
It's pitch dark. We'll talk tomorrow.

took_in.en: Now that you've explained it, I know where I stand.
took_in.zh: 你这么一解释，我心里就有数了。

took_in.en: If anyone asks me about it, I'll know what to say now.
took_in.zh: 要是还有人来问，我也知道该怎么开口了。

turned_down.en: I can't agree to that. My husband wouldn't have it.
turned_down.zh: 这个我不能应你，我家掌柜的不会答应。

turned_down.en: No, I'm afraid that won't do.

unknown.en: That one hasn't made it to me.
unknown.zh: 这件事倒没人跟我提过。

unknown.en: Nobody's said a word of it to me.
unknown.zh: 这我哪晓得，没人跟我讲过。

will_ask.en: All right, I'll go and have a word with them.
will_ask.zh: 行，我去跟人家说道说道。

will_ask.en: Good, I'll pass your word along.

will_call.en: Good, I'll call everyone to the hall right now.
will_call.zh: 好，我这就去招呼大伙儿到祠堂。

will_call.en: I'll go knock on doors. See you at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去敲门喊人，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Right, leave it to me.
Good, I'll get on it at once.

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I won't say one word more.
witness_in_public.zh: 我就看见这些，多一个字也不敢乱讲。

witness_in_public.en: I say as much as I saw. I added nothing.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见多少说多少，可没添油加醋。

lines.en: Mind it. The account is still open.
lines.zh: 记着，账还欠着。

lines.en: See you at the lanterns tonight.
lines.zh: 晚上灯会上见。

lines.en: We've shared a meal with the Lis. Let's leave it at that.
lines.zh: 跟李家吃过那顿饭，这事就搁下吧。

lines.en: The timber is delivered. The rest is up to you.
lines.zh: 木头已经送到，剩下的看你了。

lines.en: Anything more can wait till the shop is quiet.
lines.zh: 还有话，改天铺子清闲了再说。

lines.en: Mind the step. The shop must open.
lines.zh: 好走。铺子要开门了。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou made one more entry in the ledger, for what the Manager had promised and not done.
text.zh: 周掌柜在账上添了一笔，记的是总管答应了却没办的那件事。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou bowed to Granny Li at the bridgehead. The Manager kept every promise, and the shopkeeper will not forget it.
text.zh: 周掌柜在桥头跟李老太拱了拱手。总管答应的事都办到了，周掌柜记下了这份情。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou bowed to Granny Li at the bridgehead, and a lantern from the shop hung at the bridge too.
text.zh: 周掌柜在桥头跟李老太拱了拱手，铺子的灯也挂到了桥边。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou crossed the bridge and passed a few words of shop talk with the Li family.
text.zh: 周掌柜过了桥，跟李家人聊了几句买卖上的闲话。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou watched the lanterns cross from the far bank and did not speak to the Li family.
text.zh: 周掌柜在桥那头看灯过桥，没跟李家人搭话。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou took the lane too. The timber sent for the bridge still lay unused.
text.zh: 周掌柜也从夹道过去了。送去修桥的那批木料还没用上。

text.en: Shopkeeper Zhou shut the shop and hung the Zhou family's lanterns under the eaves at home.
text.zh: 周掌柜关了铺门，把周家的灯挂在了自家屋檐下。

guess_own.en: I won't state it as fact, but {hedge} {line}.
{hedge} {line}. I wouldn't put much stock in it yet.

guess_unknown.en: I couldn't tell you who passed it on, but {hedge} {line}.
Couldn't tell you who said it, but {hedge} {line}.

heard.en: I heard {teller} mention it in these terms: {line}.
It came up with {teller}. The story I heard was that {line}.

own.en: I've weighed it up, and I'd say {line}.

rival.en: I heard what you said, but {teller}'s account was that {line}.
rival.zh: 您说的我听见了，不过{teller}说{line}。

rival.en: There's the version from {teller}: {line}. I'm still weighing it up.
rival.zh: 还有{teller}那头的说法，说{line}。我还在掂量。

seen.en: I was close by and saw for myself that {line}.
seen.zh: 我当时就在跟前，{line}，这是我亲眼看见的。

seen.en: I saw plainly that {line}.

unknown.en: The word in the market is that {line}.
It's hearsay that {line}. Where it came from, I couldn't say.
unknown.zh: 听来的，{line}。从谁那儿来的，说不清。

lines.en: You must be the new Manager. If you need timber for the bridge, I've some in my storehouse. Tell me how much.
lines.zh: 想必您就是新来的总管。若是为修桥的木料来的，我库里有，您说个数。

lines.en: You didn't do what you said you would. I'll bear that in mind.
lines.zh: 上回你应下的事没办。这我得记着。

lines.en: The shop shut half the day for the lanterns tonight. Trade can wait.
lines.zh: 今晚游灯，铺子关了半天门。生意先放一放。

lines.en: The Lis ate at my table. That meal was worth it.
lines.zh: 李家人跟我同桌吃了饭。这顿饭吃得值。

lines.en: They cleared it up in front of everyone. Good. That ought to put a stop to the guessing.
lines.zh: 当着大伙的面把桥的事说清了。好，省得街上再猜。

lines.en: I've had the timber delivered and counted. Go by the bridge and see for yourself when you can.
lines.zh: 木料已经送到桥边，数也点清了，您有空过去看一眼就是。

lines.en: You did as you promised. Next time you've got business, come see me.
lines.zh: 你应的事办到了。下回有什么买卖，尽管来谈。

lines.en: I won't speak ill of the Li house in public again. It does the trade no good.
lines.zh: 李家的不是，我不再当众提了。对生意没好处。

lines.en: Again? Say it quick, the shop is waiting.
lines.zh: 又来？有话快说，铺子里等着呢。

lines.en: Go on. The price can be talked over.
lines.zh: 说吧，价钱好商量。

lines.en: How much timber do you need? Let's start with that.
lines.zh: 你要多少木料？先把数说清楚。

lines.en: Say it plainly. I have no taste for going round the houses.
lines.zh: 有话直说，我不爱绕弯子。

asleep.en: Shopkeeper Zhou is asleep and doesn't answer.
Your call doesn't wake Shopkeeper Zhou.

bamboo_arrived.en: The Li bamboo is here. My timber won't fall short either.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 李家的竹料到了，我这边木料也不会少。

bamboo_arrived.en: I've counted the bamboo that came in at the bridge.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 送到桥边的竹料我已经点过了。

batch_promised.en: That settles it. The timber will be at the bridge tomorrow morning.
batch_promised.zh: 这笔说定了，明早木料就送到桥边。

batch_promised.en: The goods come in the morning, and the count will be right.

busy.en: The shop's in the middle of business. Could we talk when it's quieter?
busy.zh: 铺子里正忙着做生意，您看能不能等我清闲些再谈？

busy.en: I'm in the middle of the accounts. Come later.
busy.zh: 手上这笔账还没算完，你晚些来。

cannot.en: That's not in my line. I can't help.
Can't be done. I can't take it on.
cannot.zh: 办不到，这桩事我接不了。

caught.en: If you can fob me off with that, Manager, I'll have to ask a few questions next time you tell me something.
caught.zh: 既然这一句都能拿来糊弄我，往后总管再开口，我可得先问明白了。

caught.en: So you made it up. We're done talking for now.
caught.zh: 原来这事是你编的。咱们先谈到这儿。

closed.en: Not convenient now. Come at another hour.
closed.zh: 现在不方便，换个时辰来。

closed.en: The shop isn't receiving now. Come later.
closed.zh: 铺子这会儿不接待，晚些再来。

deal.en: All right. I'll take the deal.

doubted.en: I heard a different account. Who did you speak to?
doubted.zh: 我听来的是另一番话。你这么说，是问过谁？

doubted.en: That's different from what I heard. Where did you get it?
doubted.zh: 这就和我听的不一样了，你是从哪儿打听来的？

elder_no.en: That doesn't add up yet.
On a few words like these, I can't agree.
elder_no.zh: 凭这几句话，我不能点头。

elder_yes.en: I follow the reasoning. Let it be done that way.
elder_yes.zh: 道理我听明白了，就照这个办。

elder_yes.en: Well argued. I have no objection.

empty.en: Words prove nothing. I don't believe it.
Nothing solid behind it. I don't take empty words.
empty.zh: 没有实在的东西，空话我不收。

evade.en: Well now, business matters aren't for telling.
evade.zh: 这个嘛，生意上的事不好讲。

evade.en: It isn't something to say outright.

gift_dislike.en: I don't touch {item}. But I'll remember the thought.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}我不碰。不过这份心意，我记着。

gift_dislike.en: No {item} for me. Thank you all the same.

gift_like.en: Some {item}? Good stuff. I'll take them.
Well, {item}. You chose well. Thank you.

gift_neutral.en: The {item} will do. It'll come in useful some day.
Some {item}, then. Thank you.

goods_enough.en: The {item} at the bridge is the full count. More would be wasted.
goods_enough.zh: 桥边的{item}够数了，再送也是白搭。

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item}. No need for more.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that talk is cleared up in public, this is not up for discussion.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那些闲话不当众说清，这事免谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Clear it up in public first. Then we can talk.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先当众把话说清楚，再谈别的。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The street is full of talk and you keep quiet, Manager. I'm not taking this deal.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话满街都是，总管却不作声。这笔买卖，我不接。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The talk isn't cleared up and you won't speak, Manager. I won't part with the goods.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 闲话没澄清，总管又不开口。这货我不出手。

hard_other.en: What's the Zhou family's isn't had for nothing.
hard_other.zh: 周家的东西，不是白拿的。

keeper_no.en: We hardly know each other yet. Not today, then.
keeper_no.zh: 咱们交情还浅，今天就免了吧。

keeper_no.en: I don't let people I've never dealt with look.
keeper_no.zh: 没打过交道的人，我不让看。

kept_thanks.en: It was done just as agreed. I can rest easier dealing with a Manager who keeps their word.
kept_thanks.zh: 果然照说好的办成了，能跟总管这样说话作数的人打交道，我也省心。

kept_thanks.en: You did what you said. I'll remember that kindness.
kept_thanks.zh: 你说到做到，这份情我记下了。

knew.en: I'd had word of that already.
I know all that.

needs_nod.en: I'd have to talk it over with my wife first.
needs_nod.zh: 这事得先跟我家那口子商量。

needs_nod.en: If the family doesn't agree, I won't settle it.
needs_nod.zh: 家里人不点头，我不拍板。

not_said.en: I never said that. Don't put words in my mouth.
not_said.zh: 我没说过这话，你可别乱安在我头上。

not_said.en: I have never said any such thing.

not_so.en: Not so. That isn't the way of it.

nothing_to_say.en: There's nothing to say on that.
I can't tell you anything about that.

objection_withdrawn.en: You've made your case clear. I won't quarrel with you over it.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 你把话说明白了，我也不跟你争这件事。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's out in the open now. I'll give way.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 话都在明面上了。我让一步。

point_heard.en: I only heard of it in passing from {name}. You'd better ask there for the particulars.
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}提了提，里头的事我也说不上来，您可以跟那边问清楚。

point_heard.en: I only heard a little. If you want the full story, ask {name}.
point_heard.zh: 我只听了几句。想问清楚就去找{name}。

point_hub.en: I don't know the matter well, but {name} hears a lot of the town's news. It might be worth asking there.
point_hub.zh: 对这事我不大熟，倒是{name}常听人讲镇上的事，您去问一声也好。

point_hub.en: If you want that kind of news, try asking {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这种事你去找{name}打听。

promise_open.en: That deal is made. It's {amount} poles of {item}, delivered to the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这笔我应下了。{amount}根{item}，{when}交到桥边。

promise_open.en: The goods are promised already. They'll reach the bridge {when}, {amount} poles of {item}.
promise_open.zh: 货已经许出去了，{when}送{amount}根{item}到桥边。

said_already.en: I've made myself quite clear.
Already said. No need to ask again.

testified.en: Every word of mine, I saw with my own eyes.
testified.zh: 我讲的句句是亲眼看见的。

testified.en: What I did not see, I will not claim.
testified.zh: 没见到的，我不会说。

timeout.en: The shop can't be left empty. I have to go back.
timeout.zh: 铺子不能没人，我得回去了。

timeout.en: It's getting late, and business comes first.
timeout.zh: 时候不早了，生意要紧。

too_late.en: It's late. We'll talk tomorrow.
We're closing. Come in the morning.

took_in.en: Now the story hangs together. I'll remember what you told me.
took_in.zh: 这样前后就对得上了，您说的我记着。

took_in.en: I understand now. Next time someone asks, I'll know how to answer.
took_in.zh: 这回听明白了，下次再有人问我也有个说法。

turned_down.en: Not at this price. I can't agree.
I can't do this. You'd better find someone else.
turned_down.zh: 这事我办不了，你另请高明吧。

unknown.en: That isn't my trade. I wouldn't know.
unknown.zh: 这不是我的行当，我不清楚。

unknown.en: Nobody at the shop has mentioned it.

will_ask.en: Fine, I'll ask them for you.
All right, I'll speak to them.

will_call.en: Very well. I'll ask everyone to the hall to talk it over.
will_call.zh: 好，我去请各位到祠堂议事。

will_call.en: I'll round everyone up. See you at the hall.
will_call.zh: 我去招呼大家，祠堂见。

will_do.en: Fair enough. I'll see to it.
Right. Count on me.

witness_in_public.en: I only vouch for what I saw. For the rest I say nothing.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只认看见的，没见的我不开口。

witness_in_public.en: What I saw I hand over in full. What I didn't see, not a word.
witness_in_public.zh: 看见的如数说出来，没看见的一个字没有。

lines.en: I won't speak of a broken word twice.
lines.zh: 失信的事，我不说第二遍。

lines.en: Tonight the lanterns in the hall and the lanterns in the street are lit together.
lines.zh: 今晚祠堂的灯和街上的灯一起亮。

lines.en: What has been made plain, the clan will remember.
lines.zh: 讲明白的事，族里会记着。

lines.en: Go on. Don't put off what needs doing.
lines.zh: 去吧，该办的事别耽搁。

lines.en: I won't see you out.
lines.zh: 老夫就不送了。

text.en: The elder lit the first lantern at the bridgehead, and the Li and Zhou families crossed together. The Manager kept every promise, and the clan book has a line for it.
text.zh: 族长在桥头点亮了头一盏灯，李、周两家一同提灯过了桥。总管答应的事都办到了，族簿上记了一笔。

text.en: The elder lit the first lantern at the bridgehead. The Li and Zhou families crossed the Stone Bridge together with lanterns in hand.
text.zh: 族长在桥头点亮了头一盏灯。李、周两家的人提着灯，一起走过了石桥。

text.en: The elder watched the lanterns cross. The bridge business was settled, but the two families still went their own ways.
text.zh: 族长看着灯过了桥。桥的事讲明白了，两家却还是各走各的。

text.en: The lanterns crossed the repaired bridge, though nobody in the clan had settled how the railing broke.
text.zh: 灯虽从修好的桥上过去了，族里还是没人说得准栏杆是怎么断的。

text.en: The bridge was not mended, so the elder led the clan through the lane behind the temple.
text.zh: 桥没修好，族长领着族人走了庙后的夹道。

text.en: The bridge was shut and the lane wasn't ready. The elder sat in the hall until late, with the lamps still unlit.
text.zh: 桥没有通，夹道也没收拾出来，族长在祠堂坐到很晚，殿里始终没点灯。

guess_own.en: {hedge} {line}. That's something we still need to clear up.

guess_unknown.en: Who started this I don't know. {hedge} {line}.
I couldn't tell you where that came from, but {hedge} {line}.
