guess_unknown.zh: 也没人说清是打哪儿听来的，{hedge}{line}。

heard.en: I got word of this from {teller}, who said {line}.
heard.zh: 老夫是从{teller}那儿听来的，说{line}。

heard.en: I heard the story from {teller}: {line}.

known.en: {line}. There is no one in town who does not know it.

own.en: I've turned it over, and I think {line}.

rival.en: But I also heard a different account from {teller}: {line}.
rival.zh: 不过我也听{teller}讲过，另有一种说法，说{line}。

rival.en: There's what I heard from {teller}: {line}. We should ask around.
rival.zh: {teller}还跟老夫说过，说{line}。这件事得再问问。

seen.en: {line}. I saw it myself and remember it well.
seen.zh: {line}，这是老夫亲眼所见，记得很清楚。

seen.en: {line}. I saw it myself.

unknown.en: Some in the clan are saying that {line}.
I only heard this, and I don't know who said it first. The word is that {line}.
unknown.zh: 这话我是听来的，谁先说的不知道。说{line}。

lines.en: Are you the Manager we asked to run the festival? Come and sit. We've time to talk.
lines.zh: 你就是请来办灯会的总管吧？来坐一坐，有什么话咱们慢慢说。

lines.en: You haven't done what you promised. The hall holds that a word given must be kept.
lines.zh: 你答应人家的事没办。祠堂里定下的，说话要算数。

lines.en: The lantern parade is tonight and the whole clan is out, young and old. You've worked hard.
lines.zh: 今晚游灯，族里老老少少都出来了。你辛苦了。

lines.en: After all this time, the Li and Zhou families have finally agreed to sit down and share a meal.
lines.zh: 等了这些日子，总算等到李、周两家肯坐下来，在一张桌上吃这顿饭。

lines.en: The bridge business was made plain in front of everyone. I accept it.
lines.zh: 桥的事当众讲明白了。我认这个理。

lines.en: The clan is all here and waiting for you at the hall. Say what you came to tell them.
lines.zh: 族人都到了，在祠堂等你。你有什么要当着大伙儿讲的，这就去讲吧。

lines.en: You did what you promised. I've written it in the clan book.
lines.zh: 你答应的事办到了，老夫记在族簿上了。

lines.en: I hear that rumour was cleared up in public.
lines.zh: 那个谣言当众说清了，我听说了。

lines.en: Back again. Sit down and speak.
lines.zh: 你又来了。坐下说。

lines.en: Something more?
lines.zh: 还有别的事？

lines.en: When both families are willing to cross the bridge with their lanterns, the job will be done.
lines.zh: 等两家都肯提灯过桥，这桩事就算办妥了。

lines.en: It's quiet in the hall. Say what you need to, and take your time.
lines.zh: 祠堂里清静，有话慢慢说。

bamboo_arrived.en: The bamboo is at the bridge. Good.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 竹料到桥边了，好。

bamboo_arrived.en: The materials are here. Work on the bridge can begin.
bamboo_arrived.zh: 料到了，桥可以动工了。

batch_promised.en: I've agreed. It will be at the bridge tomorrow morning.
First thing tomorrow, it goes to the bridge.

busy.en: There's business at the hall that still needs settling. Give me a little longer.
busy.zh: 祠堂还有事没议完，这会儿不好走开，劳你等一等。

busy.en: The clan business isn't finished yet. Go on for now.
busy.zh: 族里的事还没议完，你先回吧。

cannot.en: I can't help with this one.
That isn't the hall's business.

caught.en: I heard you out because I trusted you. Next time you'll find me slower to believe you.
caught.zh: 我原是信你才听你把话说完，往后你再来开口，老夫总得多想一想了。

caught.en: So it was a lie. I won't forget it.
caught.zh: 原来是假话。我记住了。

closed.en: This isn't the time for that. Come back later.
closed.zh: 眼下不是说这个的时候，你晚些再来。

closed.en: The hall is busy just now. Come at another hour.
closed.zh: 祠堂这会儿有事，你换个时辰。

deal.en: Then we'll do as you say.

doubted.en: What I heard was otherwise.
doubted.zh: 我听到的可不一样。

doubted.en: That doesn't agree with what I know.
doubted.zh: 这和我知道的对不上。

elder_no.en: That doesn't explain how it all came about. I'll need to hear more.
elder_no.zh: 你这几句话还没把来龙去脉讲清，我得再听听。

elder_no.en: There's still something I'm unsure of. We should ask around before we decide.
elder_no.zh: 我还有一处拿不准，事情得再问清楚才好定。

elder_yes.en: I've heard it through. We'll go ahead as you say.
elder_yes.zh: 前后都听明白了，这件事就照你说的办。

elder_yes.en: What you've just said holds together. I'll allow it.
elder_yes.zh: 你刚才说的前后对得上，这件事我准了。

empty.en: I've seen plenty of talk with no doing behind it.
empty.zh: 光说不做，老夫见得多了。

empty.en: Come and tell me once it's done.

evade.en: I know how to handle it. Go and see to what's urgent. I'll tell you when I can.
evade.zh: 这事我有分寸，你先去忙要紧的，等能讲的时候我会告诉你。

evade.en: That's not mine to speak of.

gift_dislike.en: I don't drink {item}. I accept the thought.
No need for {item}. Give it to someone who can use it.
gift_dislike.zh: {item}就不必了。拿去给用得上的人吧。

gift_like.en: Some {item}. I'll accept them. That's thoughtful.
Ah, {item}. Thank you.

gift_neutral.en: Some {item}, then. Set that down.
You've gone to trouble. I'll keep the {item}.

goods_enough.en: There's enough {item} at the bridge. Send no more there.
goods_enough.zh: 桥边的{item}已经够了，别再往那儿送。

goods_enough.en: The {item} is enough already.

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: Until that rumour is cleared up in public, this is not up for discussion.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 那个谣言没当众说清楚，这事不谈。

hard_hc_li_bamboo.en: First clear it up in front of everyone. Then we can discuss this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo.zh: 先当着众人把话说清楚，再来议这个。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The whole town is repeating this rumour and you say nothing. I can't agree to this.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 满镇都在传这个谣言，你却一句话不说。这事我不能应。

hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.en: The rumour hasn't died down, and you won't speak. I can't agree.
hard_hc_li_bamboo_rumour.zh: 谣言还没平，你也不开口。我不能答应。

hard_other.en: There's no need to raise this again.

keeper_no.en: We've only met a few times. That can wait.
keeper_no.zh: 你我才见过几面，这个以后再说。

keeper_no.en: I don't bring that out for just anyone.
keeper_no.zh: 这东西我不轻易拿出来。

kept_thanks.en: You gave your word and made good on it. I'll remember that.
kept_thanks.zh: 当初你既然应下了，今日也的确办到了，这份情我记得。

kept_thanks.en: What you promised got done. Good.
kept_thanks.zh: 答应的事办成了，好。

knew.en: I heard about that some time ago.
No need to tell me. I know.

needs_nod.en: This has to be talked over in the hall first.
needs_nod.zh: 这事得在祠堂里议过才行。

needs_nod.en: The clan hasn't discussed it, and I can't settle it alone.
needs_nod.zh: 族里没商量过，我一个人定不了。

not_said.en: I said no such thing.
That did not come from me.
not_said.zh: 这话不是从我这儿出去的。

nothing_to_say.en: I have nothing to say on this.
nothing_to_say.zh: 这件事，我没什么要说的。

nothing_to_say.en: I didn't see anything, so I can't speak to it.
nothing_to_say.zh: 我什么也没看见，说不上话。

objection_withdrawn.en: It's been made clear. I won't stand in the way any longer.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 事情说清楚了，我不再拦着。

objection_withdrawn.en: Since it was made plain in front of everyone, I have nothing against it.
objection_withdrawn.zh: 既然当众讲明了，我没有话说。

point_heard.en: I heard {name} bring it up, but I don't know what came before or after. You'll need to ask the one who told it.
point_heard.zh: 我听{name}提起过，可也不知道事情的始末，你若要问，得去找说话的人。

point_heard.en: I only heard a little from {name}. Go and ask.
point_heard.zh: 我只听{name}说了几句。去问问吧。

point_hub.en: I couldn't tell you about that. For word from the streets, you can ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 这件事我说不上来，你要打听街上的事，可以去问{name}。

point_hub.en: I won't guess. For what the neighbours say, go and ask {name}.
point_hub.zh: 我不好乱讲。街坊的事，去问{name}。

promise_open.en: That's already agreed. I'll have {amount} poles of {item} at the bridge {when}.
promise_open.zh: 这事已经应下了，{when}把{amount}根{item}送到桥边。

promise_open.en: I don't forget what I've agreed to. It's {amount} poles of {item}, delivered {when}.
promise_open.zh: 答应了的事，我记着。{amount}根{item}，{when}送到。

said_already.en: I've said it already.
I don't say a thing twice.
said_already.zh: 讲过的话，我不说第二遍。

testified.en: I saw this myself, and that is all I'm telling you.
testified.zh: 这是老夫亲眼看见的，别的不讲。

testified.en: I'm speaking up because I was there when it happened.
testified.zh: 老夫开这个口，是因为当时就在场。

timeout.en: It's time. I must get back to the hall.
timeout.zh: 时辰到了，我得回祠堂。

timeout.en: That will do for today. There are people in the clan waiting for me.
timeout.zh: 今天就说到这里。族里还有人等着。

too_late.en: It's late. Come back first thing tomorrow.
It's late at night. Whatever it is can wait till tomorrow.

took_in.en: I see. I shall remember it.
took_in.zh: 知道了，记下了。

took_in.en: So that's how it is.
took_in.zh: 原来如此。

turned_down.en: No. I won't agree to it.
The hall has its rules, and this can't be done.
turned_down.zh: 祠堂里定下的规矩，这事办不得。

unknown.en: I haven't heard of this.
Nobody has mentioned it to me.

will_ask.en: Good. I'll speak to them.
I'll take your word to them.

will_call.en: Very well. I'll call the town to the hall. Wait till they're there to speak.
will_call.zh: 成，我去把人叫到祠堂，你等大伙儿到了再说。

will_call.en: I'll call them together. Once we're at the hall, you can tell everyone in person.
will_call.zh: 人我来叫，到了祠堂，你当着大伙儿的面说。

will_do.en: Good. I'll see to it.
All right. Leave it with me.

witness_in_public.en: I tell only what I saw, and add nothing to it.
witness_in_public.zh: 我只讲看见的，一个字不添。

witness_in_public.en: That's all I saw. I know nothing beyond it.
witness_in_public.zh: 我看见的就这些，别的不知道。
